economy.zh:
今日全球金融市场迎来历史性时刻：SpaceX 以 1.77 万亿美元估值上市首日暴涨 25%，市值突破 2 万亿美元，创始人马斯克成为人类首位万亿美元富豪。这一巨量 IPO 不仅重构了美国科技股估值体系，更通过资本虹吸效应冲击香港市场——恒生指数跌至 3 月以来新低，大陆投资者跨境配置面临更严监管。欧洲方面，ECB 如期加息 25bp 但被市场视为“一次即止”，欧元区经济能否承受高利率考验成为新焦点。AI 监管升级：美国政府要求 Anthropic 屏蔽最新模型出口，对中美科技竞争格局再添变量。

- [SpaceX 首日市值破 2 万亿美元，马斯克登顶万亿富豪](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-stock-jumps-2-trillion.html) —— 散户疯狂涌入，但部分机构认为估值“愚蠢”；众议院共和党高官家属因早期投资 xAI 获益。
- [ECB 加息 25bp，市场押注“一次即止”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNZDB1bWJFUkdmbkRaSjZ4RFVqM3RsdG5QdzVFYmtlTGZ4cFhqbmxvcktnRFgzMTB4LWZ6VlZLRTZxaU1oQWRoY0tkekdfczJVcHp0QjM4YVE5QVprR2hiWW8yN2RKZXp4YXNyZTFhVkU2ejM5RFlWVFNCZ3lIUXBSR2RUOFpCZWE1ZUwzM3dOSWtMeFJ0SWxFV1N4VDctbGhjR3UwMjRFRVFlTGRjSUUtTU1vVW04RlF2SUFTTTdJSQ) —— 欧洲股市分化，ING 追问加息效果。
- [Anthropic 遭美政府指令屏蔽新 AI 模型](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/anthropic-disables-access-to-fable-5-and-mythos-5-to-comply-with-government-directive.html) —— 首次针对具体 AI 模型的出口管制，中国 EDA 企业能否借华为新架构追赶？。
- [港股大跌 437 点至 3 月来最低](https://news.google.) —— SpaceX 抽血效应叠加亚洲科技股抛售，北京收紧资本管控，香港监管承诺严打违规。
- [派拉蒙与华纳兄弟探索合并获 DOJ 批准](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/paramount-wbd-merger-approval-doj.html) —— 约 1100 亿美元交易仍面临州检察长法律挑战。
- [Fed 主席 Kevin Warsh 首次会议在即，市场关注沟通风格](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/warsh-fed-chair-interest-rates.html) —— 他坚持使用“Chairman”而非“Chair”，可能暗示政策立场。

**后续观察**：SpaceX 的财富效应能否持续？需警惕 AI 泡沫风险（[TradingKey 警告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxOWURJWnJrMkt0cjVBX3ltLVV1a3REOUx1ZjBxZXBTYnBlaXlGXzNMeGFPQ3BpX0hPTUFNTTN4eFdiYkpCQm5qaWR2M3ZRTEZ2d2tnTWU4cGpHV3JLR0hDQkVxSUZmWHJZblFkaWpSQXR1czdMZUgzX3lIenZGZXM4aHQzamZpN3dNb2ZoczZCZHJMbEI3QTNMOUNJd2NvSTQyN3M0enpWVzdMckw3OWotMGRLYVdmMERTSEp2d2wtbHA)）。美联储 6 月 24 日将公布年度银行压力测试结果，叠加伊朗和谈前景，全球风险偏好面临多重考验。
economy.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by the historic SpaceX IPO, which sent shockwaves through global markets and pushed Elon Musk past the trillion-dollar mark. Meanwhile, the ECB delivered a 25bp rate hike that split European markets, and China faced renewed capital control scrutiny as Hong Kong stocks sank to a three-month low. The US government's unprecedented export control on Anthropic's latest AI models added a geopolitical layer to tech investing. Below are the key developments across our desks.

- **SpaceX IPO mania**: Shares surged 19% on debut, pushing market cap above $2 trillion, drawing retail frenzy and insider trading allegations ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-stock-jumps-2-trillion.html)). Small investors scrambled at $135/share, despite some calling the valuation 'stupid' ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/small-investors-scrambled-to-get-in-on-the-spacex-ipo-even-as-some-believe-the-valuation-is-stupid.html)). A top House Republican's family investment stands to benefit ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/lisa-mcclain-spacex-ipo-xai-investment-congress.html)).
- **AI model export controls escalate**: Anthropic disabled access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 per US government directive, the first such action targeting specific AI models ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/anthropic-disables-access-to-fable-5-and-mythos-5-to-comply-with-government-directive.html); [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3356990/us-blocks-foreign-access-anthropics-newest-ai-models-over-security-risks)).
- **ECB raises rates 25bp**: The move was described as 'probably a one and done' by a Neuberger exec, with calls for Europe to develop a growth plan ([Business Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNZDB1bWJFUkdmbkRaSjZ4RFVqM3RsdG5QdzVFYmtlTGZ4cFhqbmxvcktnRFgzMTB4LWZ6VlZLRTZxaU1oQWRoY0tkekdfczJVcHp0QjM4YVE5QVprR2hiWW8yN2RKZXp4YXNyZTFhVkU2ejM5RFlWVFNCZ3lIUXBSR2RUOFpCZWE1ZUwzM3dOSWtMeFJ0SWxFV1N4VDctbGhjR3UwMjRFRVFlTGRjSUUtTU1vVW04RlF2SUFTTTdJSQ)). Markets split, with some questioning the point of rate hikes ([ING THINK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1pajM2SUwtZlMtOEZiMEhaLTVDaVFKZ0hCd05aRTlIVDUxOWVWOHhBRC1sVTRJeGFJMWlHS2k1WEhQMXFKYjJTNWRrRldUYlF2eE90VkV5RnNidDZUTWMtcTN3ZGhRNTQzMEtXc01nYTBZVlFCeHpF)).
- **Hong Kong stocks hit hard**: Hang Seng fell 437 points to 24,585, lowest since March, as Asia tech rout deepened ([BBN Times](https://news.google.)). Beijing's tightening of capital controls and regulators' vow to crack down on illicit cross-border flows added pressure ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356892/hong-kong-regulators-vow-strict-compliance-beijing-tightens-capital-controls)).
- **Paramount-WBD merger clears DOJ**: The $110bn deal still faces potential challenges from state attorneys general ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/paramount-wbd-merger-approval-doj.html)).
- **Iran deal optimism lifts Shanghai stocks**: A senior Trump administration official said a deal could be signed 'in coming days', boosting risk appetite ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/iran-deal-trump-pakistan-sharif.html); [Modern Diplomacy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQVGhsV29reV9nTlhTWmpvbUlROU5WM3BxdjQxYUhXaVZpQXVMc1FtUlVjWmdKUDQ0RWtCMkFTRktaX3VqLXZrdFN0bWpXbURkcDRPNG9jdkl2aUxJTXB3SXNZV0VxR2JUSHQzOGxUYWdTVEF2bTJLSHhGTlJGYmFSQzhrNUpWZw)).
- **AI bubble warnings persist**: Analysts flagged AI bubble risk and potential major correction for US stocks ([TradingKey](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxOWURJWnJrMkt0cjVBX3ltLVV1a3REOUx1ZjBxZXBTYnBlaXlGXzNMeGFPQ3BpX0hPTUFNTTN4eFdiYkpCQm5qaWR2M3ZRTEZ2d2tnTWU4cGpHV3JLR0hDQkVxSUZmWHJZblFkaWpSQXR1czdMZUgzX3lIenZGZXM4aHQzamZpN3dNb2ZoczZCZHJMbEI3QTNMOUNJd2NvSTQyN3M0enpWVzdMckw3OWotMGRLYVdmMERTSEp2d2wtbHA)).

**Watch next**: The SpaceX aftermarket frenzy will test retail staying power and regulatory scrutiny. The ECB rate path and US consumer sentiment data (improving but still low) will shape near-term risk appetite. China's capital control tightening and Hong Kong liquidity drain deserve close monitoring, as do Iran deal developments that could reshape oil markets.

今日社会新闻板块呈现多线交织：欧美方面，特朗普宣布美军击毙委内瑞拉黑帮头目、伊朗和谈接近达成、Jessie J 康复后重返中国市场；日韩聚焦世界杯热潮与漫画盗版引渡；中国 AI 模型反超 GPT-5.5 引发热议；知乎社区则围绕心理剧评分分歧展开讨论。以下是精选条目：

- 特朗普宣布美军在委内瑞拉协助下击毙 Tren de Aragua 黑帮头目 Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores，称其“迅速且致命”（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856611/u-s-military-kill-leader-tren-de-aragua) / [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/12/trump-venezuela-tren-de-aragua-leader-killed)）。此举被视为美国对委内瑞拉内部安全行动的罕见直接介入。
- 伊朗与美国、巴基斯坦调解方表示结束敌意的协议接近最终敲定，霍尔木兹海峡有望重新开放（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c39y02x98k8o)）。此前持续数月的冲突已对全球能源供应造成冲击。
- 英国歌手 Jessie J 宣布“癌症痊愈”后立即飞往中国巡演，引发对西方艺人进军中国市场的再度关注（[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/13/jessie-j-lucrative-chinese-market-westlife-charli-xcx)）。
- 中国声称境外间谍机构使用“间谍乌龟”和“间谍鱼”监测中国水域，国安部发文警告这是一场“无形秘密战争”（[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/12/china-spy-turtles-spy-fish-monitor-waters-claims)）。
- 日本消费者关于社交媒体的咨询首次突破10万件，反映网络诈骗与骚扰问题日益严重（[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQM1BaMmVJTms4MnoxZ05UMGN6b0ptZXg1Sl9sQUJMTElxSnY0SThNN1FLaTZtY1FPeFRiZzl5amlQaW1Ucmo4eEVyWWw4Mnd4V1VlczNqX2JPTy1vRVk1ODZaTlNqSXFoMWxmbVFrWER0aHZsV0IzcHVBeTJYalJORTlEOGRWVVpOV2t0cmtUclBTYnM)）。
- 法国11岁女孩 Lyhanna 被杀，嫌疑人九个月前曾被举报但未受讯问，引发警方失职质疑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy9rq21dqego)）。
- 中国 AI 模型在多项基准测试中反超 GPT-5.5，新浪财经报道称“纯血AI”实现突破（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNd1FHQmR6T0RZQnNBbXNoWVhqcThJUkpfRUNOWXI4bmwyLTBMbjBWaHkwc1I3S0c4ay1YR0EyajlOazZyeTdBSTZnNXN3TDRJamxBd1NVdUdZWE9LOFgzWEtqcThlOG1lQWNzZEt2dVdYUnZQTUZ1bm1iZ0ZwQ3FJeTFqWU1XMGgtU09SOG5UNU9XWXF0M1VzZ2V2V1l3T25XR2RfUmNzbHpGakR6VDNISXBR)）。
- 知乎社区热议《女心理师》豆瓣评分仅5.1但获心理专业人士认可，分歧引发对影视作品评价标准的讨论（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQQVo1YWd6ZkxxcmdfVHN0d1BBRUpiZ2t3elhSUXhpckZzbHB6ajhVWml6dUd5U0RVRTBJSW51WWkwSVZ1d1F3ejVERHZxTXNsM3h1LTNfcDBlSnYyNnhKcWRHRHFXNlVUdGdsR1kwcEJXR3BfVEdveE9DTFNyVW5VSA)）。

**后续观察**：特朗普的军事行动可能加剧美委紧张；伊朗和谈若成功将缓解油价压力；Jessie J 的中国之行检验西方艺人市场策略；中国 AI 突破引发全球大模型竞争新回合。
society.en:
The past 24 hours in social news have been dominated by a mix of geopolitical tension, cultural milestones, and generational shake-ups. The US military strike killing a Venezuelan gang leader signals a new phase in international counter-crime operations, while ongoing Iran peace talks inch closer to reopening the Strait of Hormuz. In culture, the death of artist David Hockney and Taylor Swift's historic Songwriters Hall of Fame induction mark poignant moments, while the World Cup continues to produce on- and off-field drama, from empty-seat controversies to political tensions around Iran's first match on US soil. Meanwhile, China's AI sector claims a notable breakthrough, and Japanese society grapples with public etiquette debates and rising social media complaints. Below are the key developments across all desks.

- **US military kills Tren de Aragua leader**: President Trump announced a 'swift and lethal' strike killed Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores, with Venezuelan cooperation, marking a significant cross-border counter-gang operation. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856611/u-s-military-kill-leader-tren-de-aragua) | [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/12/trump-venezuela-tren-de-aragua-leader-killed)
- **Iran peace deal near but not signed**: US, Iran, and mediators Pakistan signal a deal to end fighting that would reopen the Hormuz strait; a live blog notes Palestine Action activists jailed in the UK. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c39y02x98k8o) | [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/13/iran-war-live-us-tehran-signal-peace-deal-within-reach-but-not-signed-yet)
- **David Hockney dies at 88**: King Charles leads tributes to 'one of life's true originals'; the artist's passing reshapes the contemporary art landscape. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgjxdr27z4o)
- **World Cup: Iran set to play on US soil amid war**: Iran's opening match against New Zealand in Los Angeles makes it the first country to play a host nation it is at war with; flag bans and travel headaches add tension. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/12/iran-first-play-war-world-cup-fifa)
- **Jessie J's return spotlights China market**: The cancer-free star's performance underscores the lucrative Chinese music market, with other Western acts attempting to follow. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/13/jessie-j-lucrative-chinese-market-westlife-charli-xcx)
- **China claims AI leap**: A domestic model surpasses GPT-5.5 in benchmarks, signaling increased competition in the global AI race. [Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNd1FHQmR6T0RZQnNBbXNoWVhqcThJUkpfRUNOWXI4bmwyLTBMbjBWaHkwc1I3S0c4ay1YR0EyajlOazZyeTdBSTZnNXN3TDRJamxBd1NVdUdZWE9LOFgzWEtqcThlOG1lQWNzZEt2dVdYUnZQTUZ1bm1iZ0ZwQ3FJeTFqWU1XMGgtU09SOG5UNU9XWXF0M1VzZ2V2V1l3T25XR2RfUmNzbHpGakR6VDNISXBR)
- **French town buries murdered child, police failures emerge**: Suspect in Lyhanna's death was reported nine months ago but never questioned. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy9rq21dqego)
- **Japanese society debates eating in public**: A viral video of a grandmother scolding a woman for eating in a park sparks intergenerational tension about manners. [TOY PEOPLE](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE9oLUlZS0czRG53dm9maFU0Z3BNMk80cGZVMjkzRXQtVnRhYmVzc2gzTXNyNkc5MENadjJnQlFvZzNxaURFV1g5bXVRSzZHRmxH)

**Watch next**: The Iran peace deal's finalisation could dramatically impact global oil markets and shipping lanes; the World Cup's Iran match on Monday will test diplomatic protocols; and China's AI breakthrough may accelerate export controls or tech rivalry.

military.zh:
过去24小时，伊朗战争持续引发全球震荡，霍尔木兹海峡封锁不仅导致航运成本翻倍，还造成3名印度船员死亡；美军A-10攻击机携任务标记抵达英国，THAAD系统拦截率宣称达90%。与此同时，F-35战备率跌至25%的历史低点，俄罗斯加速北极军事部署，欧洲六代机项目分裂。中国海军为何重拾“大舰巨炮”引发讨论，美中科技战再升级——美国国会提案禁止中国军方关联企业员工入境。

- **伊朗战争全面升级**：美军A-10攻击机抵达英国，机身涂有“史诗愤怒”任务标记，暗示其在伊朗战斗中发挥关键作用；THAAD系统拦截90%伊朗导弹，但美国库存告急。印度证实3名船员死于美军对霍尔木兹海峡的打击，另有10人因飞机坠毁死亡。美国智库评估伊朗海军基础设施与战术。[A-10抵达英国](https://www.twz.com/air/a-10-warthogs-arrive-in-england-festooned-with-nose-art-and-mission-markings-from-epic-fury)、[印度人死亡](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOQWVkMXBDa0drWDFKRUhBTXlkVVh1eEtHLWdyV2lSQjRWTXBvc0ZfTno3bXpwbzZyWVdPNGZvV2doVUtzaVRSMUxqTXlWRTg3anBqZ2Z6M29tcGhKVXl6OUlLT3FWTVBHMWZkb2tNNE1OOWZjbzZpLXZtYjU3c3lrZHpHb21LSWNLdUo4dXlGNFBCODF1cHU2N2JUVXZmSXhVZlN1Ui03dGlwWnc)、[THAAD](https://news.google.)、[伊朗海军评估](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQUEJaRFBzRVA3ODZXSTFGQjlBRnJxS25pcW5iTWcyV2o3WDBfTTRhYVQ0TjJxb09DT2lmc2JMUTlJMGh4aVRCdFE2OTZoSlEyeUNFYnZEcHRpU1FsOFhjSDBYcXZkYmFCYVFJOWd6VjNIVFptSDBuM1JTYkRDeXQ5WTZKeUU1R2E0aXh0WA)
- **全球航运与能源冲击**：伊朗战争导致集装箱运价飙升超100%，燃油成本暴涨；和平报告警告全球经济可能损失2.2万亿美元。[航运](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNa3RsREYydTNRS00tcVJOSHlsZVBDU3lmcHJ2MGpFS0hhbHNMM0NPZnhxdHhhWDlfZWhFZWJSUllPamdUVGxUd0NUQXpUV2Nxa2NFU25fUFNhMTFTa1BYTXV6NmhGcXZjY1dfS1E1TXI2UmdIdmNXb2kyWHlBTXlWczRpTEljLWdERXRwUnFiQjgxZHNIQmtBMXZLM09wekVnMWFaNmZEV0dNc1ZhRmlLMkRLb3g)、[经济成本](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQNzU4a2hoY0JGZXoteXl5SEdaYzlGWHgyX2Z4amxfRllMSDJNWVNNMmMxVmIyMTR3bEhmdDdYTWdBLUp0T1hqbU1kVloySENUNkdrbmxuS3VyYnhzU3pNWXlVUnhUM3RRRGFvOWRnN09pZFdkUmV4WDhLSDlnMTE3U256M3FfSEZMdmtyREpfRWxvTURGZDMzSVhUck51b0k)
- **F-35战备率创历史新低**：美国政府问责局发现，F-35机队“完全任务能力”率降至仅25%，引发对五代机可靠性的质疑。[F-35](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/06/12/only-1-in-4-f-35s-is-fully-mission-capable-gao-finds/)
- **俄罗斯北极部署**：俄正沿北约北翼建设大规模驻军基础设施，北约则组建新的北极作战部队以威慑。[北极](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russia-building-new-infrastructure-for-major-troop-deployments-along-natos-northern-flank)
- **欧洲六代机项目内部分裂**：德国和西班牙在FCAS（未来空战系统）崩溃后启动“Team Gen 6”，欧洲未来战斗机格局面临重塑。[六代机](https://www.twz.com/air/germany-and-spain-launch-team-gen-6-after-europes-next-gen-fighter-effort-collapses)
- **中国海军重返“巨舰大炮”**：南华早报分析称，中国海军在拥有导弹和无人机后，为何重新重视舰载火炮？暗示近海博弈与成本考量。[中国舰炮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPWDdKbzlPT0JhVzhibDZwMTNvMkNkTHRKbjVRRzlVZy12SzFxVjdUQkk2LXd3UE1iWTE0ZWVpZDlBMS1JN1l0X1BuaFVwRWJ3YlFYZlctbTJ5cTNLSTktLU51Z00xWnVNYldyUU1TQ2twYkxKTWVFUEFUbE93TGIwQS1kbTdhbnk2cUxjeEM1SFNVMmNmUFVCcUd4SFlZX0dmRFRLalZGRjJCM1BraHc4YTZiSjJnV2Nra0llUkpZNA)
- **美中科技战升级**：美国会议员提案禁止中国军方关联企业员工入境并驱逐在美人员；中国商务部批美“罔顾共识”。[提案](https://news.google.)、[商务部回应](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9mMUhFem1tQV9yWldpd2VBbkZhMk1HNjZWQ1hhMktMX0VVTTBuczFUdS14dmFKN2ZXNmstYmZ4RHRBOWVCeS04SEhjVDZLTUxUUXhJRGxWZXlRdFhrVVAzOWdOZHBFTnUzUUJwNDZFTkpuMUVLTWdv)

**后续观察**：伊朗战争的连锁反应正在重塑全球军事与经济格局：亚太供应链面临抬升压力，美国军力因F-35低战备率而承压，俄罗斯趁乱加强北极存在。中国在南海与台海方向保持军事活跃，同时应对美国科技打压。未来一周需关注霍尔木兹海峡局势是否降温、欧洲六代机能否吸引新伙伴、以及F-35机队修复计划的进展。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by the aftermath of the US-Iran conflict and its cascading effects on global security, economic stability, and military posture. Key developments include the first confirmed Indian civilian casualties from US strikes near Hormuz, the arrival of combat-marked A-10s in the UK, and a GAO report revealing that only 1 in 4 F-35s is fully mission capable. Meanwhile, Russia is building infrastructure for major troop deployments along NATO's northern flank, and Europe's next-generation fighter program has fractured with Germany and Spain launching a rival coalition. In the Indo-Pacific, China continues to assert itself with exercises targeting Japan, while the US plans a new nuclear submarine base in Australia. The section also covers naval modernization efforts from France, Turkey, Greece, and Indonesia.

- **Iran Conflict Casualties & Logistics**: Three Indian seafarers were killed in US strikes near Hormuz, and a jet crash killed 10 more ([NDTV](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOQWVkMXBDa0drWDFKRUhBTXlkVVh1eEtHLWdyV2lSQjRWTXBvc0ZfTno3bXpwbzZyWVdPNGZvV2doVUtzaVRSMUxqTXlWRTg3anBqZ2Z6M29tcGhKVXl6OUlLT3FWTVBHMWZkb2tNNE1OOWZjbzZpLXZtYjU3c3lrZHpHb21LSWNLdUo4dXlGNFBCODF1cHU2N2JUVXZmSXhVZlN1Ui03dGlwWnc)). The UAE has airlifted South Korea's M-SAM-II missile system via eight C-17s, signaling rapid Gulf alliance adaptation ([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQQUdjNGMyeEx3S0RzeWdrdldQeVdkeHo1cUZZbXZtRWREd2ZjSGNyQlJkOWhaX2YxNHZGc0hBVG9LY0U0NGhsd2lVRFUtUlBuQ2o4c3FlLVZEenl1YmUtckxsLVNfWTFQZkRtWEJZd1Z5NWR1NXhPMDFLSm1sZ2tOMGpURG5hcXVyOUlNS0FSZFYzbGtzZm9IX2pwT0ZkVk8yZmpRag)).
- **US Military Readiness & Posture**: GAO found the F-35 full mission capable rate fell to 25% ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/06/12/only-1-in-4-f-35s-is-fully-mission-capable-gao-finds/)). Congress is blocking U-2 retirement, restoring four planes ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/four-u-2s-spy-planes-would-be-restored-in-bill-that-would-save-the-dragon-lady-fleet)). THAAD, which failed six tests in the 1990s, now intercepts 90% of Iranian missiles but stocks are running low ([19FortyFive](https://news.google.)). The Army commissioned a second cohort of tech executives into Detachment 201 to bridge commercial-military gaps ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/12/us-army-commissions-second-cohort-of-tech-executives-into-innovation-unit/)).
- **NATO-Russia Northern Flank**: Russia is building infrastructure for tens of thousands of troops near NATO's northern flank; NATO is responding with a new Arctic combat force ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russia-building-new-infrastructure-for-major-troop-deployments-along-natos-northern-flank)).
- **European Fighter Split**: Germany and Spain launched 'Team Gen 6' after the EU next-gen fighter effort collapsed, reshaping Europe's fighter landscape ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/germany-and-spain-launch-team-gen-6-after-europes-next-gen-fighter-effort-collapses)).
- **China Military & US Countermeasures**: China held exercises with Japan as 'mock enemy' ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOR01MMFhveU1rTHROV0JNc013R0l6ajAxVUlCMFNmdXQxQ2RaZDJ3WFExa0M3Mk93aUp1YUxoV01odUppaEw4VldyMHVuNGN1SkFjejFGN1p3djZvTFl6S0pqekwwMWhEQWZrckZMRE0tUzNVdTBvYWF1d0lmckJJa1BwbVRPNk5IUUFFLS1IS1R2b2ZuS3JBNw)). US lawmakers propose banning Chinese military-linked employees from the US ([VOA](https://news.google.)). China's navy is reviving gun systems despite missile and drone focus ([SCMP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPWDdKbzlPT0JhVzhibDZwMTNvMkNkTHRKbjVRRzlVZy12SzFxVjdUQkk2LXd3UE1iWTE0ZWVpZDlBMS1JN1l0X1BuaFVwRWJ3YlFYZlctbTJ5cTNLSTktLU51Z00xWnVNYldyUU1TQ2twYkxKTWVFUEFUbE93TGIwQS1kbTdhbnk2cUxjeEM1SFNVMmNmUFVCcUd4SFlZX0dmRFRLalZGRjJCM1BraHc4YTZiSjJnV2Nra0llUkpZNA)).
- **Naval & Indo-Pacific**: USS George Washington and Liaoning CSG operate in Philippine Sea ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-june-12-2026)). France commissions ASN4G hypersonic missile development ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/french-dga-commissions-mbda-to-develop-asn4g-hypersonic-missile/)). US Army tested drone-dropping balloons from landing craft ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-army-landing-craft-launches-drone-dropping-high-altitude-balloons/)).

**Watch next**: The economic fallout of the Iran conflict will deepen as shipping rates have doubled ([Marine Insight](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNa3RsREYydTNRS00tcVJOSHlsZVBDU3lmcHJ2MGpFS0hhbHNMM0NPZnhxdHhhWDlfZWhFZWJSUllPamdUVGxUd0NUQXpUV2Nxa2NFU25fUFNhMTFTa1BYTXV6NmhGcXZjY1dfS1E1TXI2UmdIdmNXb2kyWHlBTXlWczRpTEljLWdERXRwUnFiQjgxZHNIQmtBMXZLM09wekVnMWFaNmZEV0dNc1ZhRmlLMkRLb3g)). Turkey’s push to end the Ukraine war for Black Sea security and the UAE’s rapid missile shield deployment signal a reshaping of regional alliances. Monitor Congress’s bills on U-2 restoration and Chinese military-linked employee bans for near-term policy moves.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现三重冲击波：**SpaceX上市**引爆资本市场与政治争议，马斯克成为全球首位万亿富翁，但Robinhood出现宕机，且The Verge刊发评论《万亿富翁是杀人犯》直指其道德责任；**美国政府罕见动用国家安全令**强制下架Anthropic最新AI模型Fable 5和Mythos 5，引发对行政干预边界的激烈辩论；**AI自主武器实战化**再迈一步——乌克兰首次使用全自主无人机击杀俄军。同时，中国新能源军团加速扩张，小米实现特斯拉十年前概念；FFmpeg被发现21个零日漏洞敲响基础软件安全警钟。**后续观察**：本周核心矛盾集中在“监管权力边界”与“技术加速主义”的碰撞——AI模型被政府直接关停创下先例，或推动开源/闭源路线之争激化；SpaceX IPO带来的财富集中效应也将在后续政策讨论中持续发酵。

- [SpaceX IPO首日涨19%，马斯克成首位万亿富翁，Robinhood出现技术故障](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-closes-up-19-and-delivers-the-worlds-first-trillionaire/)，多家媒体交叉印证，但The Verge[发文](https://www.theverge.com/tech/949259/the-worlds-first-trillionaire-is-a-killer)批评其行为直接导致数十万人死亡。
- [美国政府依据商务部指令，要求Anthropic下线Fable 5和Mythos 5](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/anthropic-shuts-down-fable-mythos-models-following-trump-admin-directive/)，理由是存在“越狱”风险。Anthropic公开表达不满（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/anthropics-safety-warnings-may-have-just-backfired-the-government-has-pulled-the-plug-on-its-most-powerful-ai/)）。
- [乌克兰在一次测试中部署全自主无人机杀死俄军士兵](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/ukraines-one-time-test-used-fully-autonomous-drones-to-kill-russian-soldiers/)，标志着AI武器进入新阶段。
- [中国限制西方AI模型，但美国公司却涌向DeepSeek](https://www.techradar.com/pro/the-great-ai-irony-china-cracks-down-on-western-models-while-us-companies-flock-to-deepseek)，形成政策反差。
- [小米发布家用机器人充电臂，自动插拔EV充电枪](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/xiaomi-robotic-arm-ev-charger-tesla-snake-charger/)，特斯拉十年前原型概念首次商用化。
- [BYD目标五年内成为世界最大汽车制造商](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPbnVWRmhCOGFqSDhvZjU0cUlUdHd0MjRLM2luRG0zY0xxN2t3LW9uM1NxNHNNRW40V0JpQnAxX0hObmp2OUZnb21hcjJJZUFnR19kMlZmRllmbmp6VnpsUEpoTmhfZzFRYmFMWVBvNTJCSVF6aWR4QmZVVU56MEZJSVQxTDdXQ05kYWhvRzdCdXo5dTAzdXFwaW9jaEh4Y2sxaC1qQnViejY)，已超越福特。
- [社区聚焦：FFmpeg被曝21个零日漏洞](https://depthfirst.com/research/21-zero-days-in-ffmpeg)；[Palantir在瑞士输掉对调查杂志的法律挑战](https://www.ft.com/content/7ffcace7-9dc0-4e7e-9912-895ac073f979)；[Renault发布无稀土电机技术](https://www.renaultgroup.com/en/magazine/energy-and-powertrains/all-about-electric-motors-with-no-rare-earths/)引发热议。
tech.en:
The tech landscape this week is defined by seismic shifts in AI regulation, market milestones, and automotive ambitions. The U.S. government's unprecedented order to shut down Anthropic's most powerful AI models over a jailbreak concern has ignited a fierce debate on national security versus open innovation. Meanwhile, SpaceX's blockbuster IPO minted Elon Musk as the world's first trillionaire, triggering record trading volumes and a surge of interest in the 'MANGOS' cohort of companies headed to public markets. In the AI arena, Ukraine's deployment of fully autonomous drones marks a chilling new phase in conflict technology, while the open-source AI community rallies against regulatory overreach. The auto sector sees BYD targeting global dominance with a 1,000-km luxury sedan, and Xiaomi resurrects Tesla's decade-old robot charger concept. Deep technical vulnerabilities—from a critical PeopleSoft zero-day to 21 FFmpeg flaws—remind us that digital infrastructure remains fragile amid rapid innovation.

- **Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models shut down** by U.S. Commerce Department order over a 'jailbreak' security risk, sparking industry-wide backlash and uncertainty about future AI governance ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/anthropic-shuts-down-fable-mythos-models-following-trump-admin-directive/), [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/anthropics-safety-warnings-may-have-just-backfired-the-government-has-pulled-the-plug-on-its-most-powerful-ai/)).
- **SpaceX IPO closes up 19%**, making Elon Musk the world's first trillionaire and causing 'record-breaking' traffic on Robinhood with intermittent outages ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-closes-up-19-and-delivers-the-worlds-first-trillionaire/), [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/elon-musk-is-the-worlds-first-trillionaire-wow/)).
- **Ukraine tested fully autonomous drones** with AI modules that killed Russian soldiers in a one-time operational use, raising urgent ethical and military questions ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/ukraines-one-time-test-used-fully-autonomous-drones-to-kill-russian-soldiers/)).
- **BYD reveals 'Great Han' luxury EV** with over 1,000 km range and sets a goal to become the world's largest automaker within five years, having already outsold Ford ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/byd-launch-luxury-ev-sedan-with-1000-km-range/), [Moomoo](https://news.google.)).
- **Open source AI must win** campaign gains traction with 559 points on Hacker News, opposing the government's model shutdown and advocating for decentralized development ([Hacker News](https://opensourceaimustwin.com/?share=v2)).
- **Xiaomi launches home robotic arm EV charger**, delivering on Tesla's 'snake charger' concept from a decade ago, integrating into smart home ecosystems ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/xiaomi-robotic-arm-ev-charger-tesla-snake-charger/)).
- **Critical PeopleSoft 0-day** affecting hundreds of organizations is stealing gigabytes of data, described by Ars Technica as 'about as critical as they come' ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/06/peoplesoft-0-day-affecting-hundreds-of-organizations-steals-gigabytes-of-data/)).
- **21 zero-day vulnerabilities discovered in FFmpeg**, the widely used multimedia framework, prompting urgent patches and community discussion ([Hacker News](https://depthfirst.com/research/21-zero-days-in-ffmpeg)).

**Watch next:** The fallout from the Anthropic shutdown could accelerate a regulatory push for AI model licensing, while SpaceX's IPO success may catalyze a wave of tech listings. In the EV space, BYD's range breakthrough and Xiaomi's robotic charger will test consumer adoption. Security teams should prioritize patching PeopleSoft and FFmpeg immediately.

sports.zh:
## 体育日报：2026-06-13

世界杯大幕拉开，东道主美国队在揭幕战中以4-1大胜巴拉圭，巴洛贡梅开二度，45分钟精彩表现打消外界质疑。英格兰队则遭遇训练器材失窃的尴尬，为即将到来的比赛蒙上阴影。篮球方面，国内篮球名宿朱芳雨将空降北大iQOO × NBA高校篮球赛总决赛，与郭艾伦、特奎维恩等一同助阵，话题度拉满。虎扑社区热议电竞赛事，T1不敌HLE后无缘MSI，Gumayusi创下连续五年晋级MSI的纪录；同时社区内关于娱乐明星的话题也引发讨论。羽毛球赛场，澳大利亚公开赛1/4决赛战罢，中国队锁定男双决赛席位，小将董天尧延续黑马之旅。

- [USA start World Cup in style - but will they finally join the elite?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c621z2k51rdo) — 美国4-1大胜巴拉圭，BBC质问这支球队能否真正跻身精英行列。
- [Balogun stars in impressive USA win over Paraguay](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/videos/cwydp9463wko) — 巴洛贡两球，洛杉矶体育场见证东道主开门红。
- [VAR makes 'mistaken identity' history as strange booking confuses fans](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c5yze890365o) — VAR出现“认错人”闹剧，美国队的黄牌判罚令人困惑。
- [England have training equipment stolen](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cwyldy8w0jpo) — 英格兰队训练器材在抵达堪萨斯城前被盗，球队备战受阻。
- [来，陪你玩到底！CBA“三分雨”朱芳雨空降北大！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8wVkZ1emNvSUF4RVFRUnl6cU9nd1dLckxFUUZhaURpU2JaYmRtMnpBOHBsd0l5dWxVblhNOC1oSU8tTHV3amx3V2M5ZU5qTTc5cjdzaFhWVGZjMllQOVlwUW9OMA) — 6月14日北大，iQOO×NBA高校篮球赛总决赛，朱芳雨现场助阵。
- [2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛1/4决赛综述：中国队锁定男双决赛席位，董天尧延续惊喜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPcnFrZ3YxWTNKU2t6YkZsU2pDWldKeUlfUl9qbnZHY1RLLWhlWHEzbkVPMUtSdWlfWk9RbmRGanQxQzk1czE4YmpfNk5nQzdXc0NCTjRwZlkxR0dnNEgwY292OGtvMWJTMWtCblZWZEdTOVJnem5abDBEVGkzUGFuX2NhWW9qXzFjUDlwa3RucmZOV041Z05EOFV0ZlhDM184SjhhWURPUQ) — 国羽男双提前锁定决赛名额，小将董天尧持续带来惊喜。

**后续观察**：世界杯首轮还在继续，美国队能否保持状态值得关注；英格兰的装备失窃事件是否影响后续比赛？篮球高校赛决赛的明星效应能否带动校园体育热度？虎扑电竞讨论中T1的失利意味着LCK格局变化，而羽毛球澳大利亚公开赛决赛日国羽能否再添金牌？
sports.en:
The last 24 hours in sports have been dominated by the USA's emphatic 4-1 World Cup opener against Paraguay, raising questions about their transition from host nation to elite contender. Elsewhere, China's basketball scene buzzes with a star-studded university final, while the LCK sees HLE eliminate T1 from MSI contention, sparking intense fan debate. In badminton, China locks a men's doubles final spot at the Australian Open.

- **[USA start World Cup in style - but will they finally join the elite?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c621z2k51rdo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — A dominant first half dispelled doubts about the hosts' readiness; Folarin Balogun's brace and a 4-1 victory over Paraguay set the tone for a deep run.
- **[VAR makes 'mistaken identity' history as strange booking confuses fans](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c5yze890365o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The win was overshadowed by a bizarre VAR incident that left players and pundits baffled, potentially setting a precedent for World Cup officiating.
- **[England have training equipment stolen](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cwyldy8w0jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The Three Lions' preparation hit a snag ahead of their arrival in Kansas City, a logistical distraction as the tournament heats up.
- **[Topuria shoves Gaethje in front of Lincoln Memorial before UFC Freedom](https://www.bbc.com/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/c0eywew2x90o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — A heated pre-fight confrontation underscores the high stakes of Sunday's White House UFC event, blending sports and political spectacle.
- **[郭艾伦、朱芳雨、特奎维恩已就位...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1PMUpLNWp0a1RZMjl6THRVTjJmODFQUmRLQVU0V3FWWWFVN1Z5LVZWdjFVUU51UjRaZVdJN0NOMGZiVFZjbFZDcklYTnZMTG0yclpmN2lxTFZyMms5TXVGRWo3bw)** — iQOO x NBA高校篮球赛 attracts legends like Zhu Fangyu and Guo Ailun, plus a mystery NBA/CBA dual champion, indicating growing crossover between Chinese basketball and commercial activation.
- **[Gumayusi becomes first to reach five consecutive MSI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBGSU5xaHpoNHpLbWMyc3k0ODBzTUxsY2R6ZFZaUlF4OVJVZmVKaDJ2eVdXYklvUmdQWDM3ZHlUNFZxSVY0YnI4OGZNVTFTRTZJSTRTY05nVl9qM2RXclRmek9sMA)** — Despite T1's loss to HLE, Gumayusi's individual consistency remains remarkable; the LCK landscape shifts as HLE advances to MSI.
- **Watch next:** The USA's next World Cup match, the upcoming UFC Freedom event, and the iQOO x NBA final on June 14 will shape the narrative. Keep an eye on England's recovery from their equipment theft and the fallout from the VAR controversy.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块核心事件：好莱坞迎来世纪并购——华纳兄弟以1110亿美元出售给派拉蒙获司法部批准，重塑全球媒体版图；韩国科幻片《Colony》以24天破500万观影人次的成绩碾压去年冠军；中国娱乐圈署名规则重大改革，三协会联手禁止“撕番”，7月起按笔画排序。此外，BTS与BOYNEXTDOOR双双刷新纪录，微博热搜被迪丽热巴绯闻与何炅救场占据。

- [华纳兄弟1110亿美元出售给派拉蒙获美司法部批准](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjwgled9jxwo)，交易将包含CNN、HBO等资产，后续仍需其他监管放行，好莱坞进入寡头竞争时代。
- [肯尼迪中心请求延期移除特朗普名字](https://deadline.com/2026/06/trump-kennedy-center-name-removed-1236955117/)，法院截止日过后因雷暴申请12小时缓冲，政治与艺术拉锯进入尾声。
- [韩国电影《Colony》超500万观影人次](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847425wpp/colony-surpasses-5-million-moviegoers-faster-than-2025s-biggest-box-office-hit)，速度超越2025年票房冠军，成为下半年首部现象级本土大片。
- [中国三大协会联合发布演员署名新规](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOY2JVVDFna0Frd19fNnhoTUJOa3k1LXQ4WjYySHBCZW1JalhIeGdzc05CQV9TeWNpQ19nZTF2UHNqYTJnTVRmVFVNTndmZnMzdWNwME5qbkhwUUNlN0ZBMlprWVZtS2FrTGJUcnV4QjY4LURfUThaRFh4YVVyWTg4eThPTlp0NUk3anlmcXZzUDdjMi1TZ0F4Uw)，7月起按姓氏笔画排序，彻底终结“番位之争”。
- [BTS新单曲《Come Over》横扫全球iTunes](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847422wpp/bts-dominates-itunes-charts-all-over-the-world-with-come-over)，作为黑胶隐藏曲单独发行，验证顶级流量的商业韧性。
- [迪丽热巴与陈飞宇秘恋话题登微博热搜榜首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5oWlRDRUdSMzhsY2hnVjJBc0hFMmxCY2ZyQUxfVGd6NHRZci1KQjNzVmYwLXNRQkYzaGxTWXoydUVVMV9JOG50LTdZbXR4RF9GNHd4UEdSSm90UFh0VmfSAWNBVV95cUxQQWJJTkw1ZHYzRktZN0pKTzB3bHhTblJoT3VxWEV3c2xsYVZSNzhhcVRRRkRncFJxaFVWRXpQa3Excmh1ZHQ2TjJHYUFlS096RWRWcmZfcENGTll4Q3NQQWNxMUk)，迪丽热巴方随后否认，但话题持续发酵。

**后续观察**：华纳-派拉蒙合并将引发好莱坞裁员与业务重组，短期内影响影视项目投资节奏；中国署名新规实施后，演员团队宣发策略需全面调整；《Colony》能否在暑期档冲击千万票房，将是韩国本土市场风向标。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape is undergoing structural shifts this week, with mega-mergers, regulatory crackdowns, and cross-border box office surprises dominating the news. From the US Justice Department approving the $111 billion Warner Bros-Paramount merger to China's industry-wide ban on credit disputes, the forces reshaping Hollywood and Asia's entertainment sectors are accelerating. Meanwhile, BTS and BOYNEXTDOOR continue their chart dominance, and the Emmy race enters its critical voting phase.

- **Media M&A heats up:** The US DOJ approved the $111bn Warner Bros-Paramount merger ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjwgled9jxwo)), while Roku's stock surged 20% on sale talks ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/roku-for-sale-stock-jumps-20-percent-on-report-1236620804/)). These moves signal a major consolidation wave that will affect content pipelines and streaming competition.
- **China targets 'credit wars' in casting:** Starting July, all actor credits must be sorted by stroke count of surnames, after three industry associations jointly issued new rules to combat 'credit-stealing' disputes ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOY2JVVDFna0Frd19fNnhoTUJOa3k1LXQ4WjYySHBCZW1JalhIeGdzc05CQV9TeWNpQ19nZTF2UHNqYTJnTVRmVFVNTndmZnMzdWNwME5qbkhwUUNlN0ZBMlprWVZtS2FrTGJUcnV4QjY4LURfUThaRFh4YVVyWTg4eThPTlp0NUk3anlmcXZzUDdjMi1TZ0F4Uw)). This will directly impact how Chinese productions negotiate salaries and marketing.
- **Emmy voting reaches fever pitch:** With nomination ballots due, analysis suggests a record number of series are in contention, and the Directors Guild's new deal includes AI training provisions ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/emmy-nomination-voting-hits-fever-pitch-notes-on-the-season-1236955423/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/directors-guilds-four-year-deal-plan-1236620542/)). The intersection of awards and labor negotiations is a key story for industry professionals.
- **Box office: 'Colony' surges in Korea, while US summer season builds:** The Korean sci-fi film reached 5 million admissions faster than any 2025 hit ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847425wpp/colony-surpasses-5-million-moviegoers-faster-than-2025s-biggest-box-office-hit)), proving that local IP can dominate globally. In the US, the World Cup opening ceremony featured Katy Perry, Future, and Tyla ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/katy-perry-tius-perform-world-cup-2026-1235577061/)), blending sports and entertainment marketing.
- **Ariana Grande launches mental health foundation:** The Brighter Days Ahead Foundation will support youth mental health and arts education ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/ariana-grande-brighter-days-ahead-foundation-1236955560/)), adding a philanthropic dimension to her ongoing touring and recording activity.
- **Chinese celebrity gossip dominates Weibo:** Alleged romance between Dilraba Dilmurat and Chen Feiyu sparked massive traffic ([新浪网](https://news.google.)), while He Jiong's on-stage rescue of Na Ying went viral ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPTU9ORTBwVmZxT2YwUzY1NkhYbVRya3Atd0dVZ0NZaEFJelNBeUJ6dnNqV1NDMW0ybGk1MTFQSkgxUHdfLXRocXZoUW13TmRIZDU4Q1NZcHZYN3NPdHNrekhteUxrLWMxem16aFNNd0VHWHJBdUNubkJJd3FjTTN3Uw)). These micro-dramas reflect the intense fan economy in China.
- **AI marches into film production:** China's 'Aillwood' concept and Huace's new AIGC center in Tonglu ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPTXB4M003ODNPZmc0LVlDenh6V0tiZTZNcnBzWm15U19BaUVyQ1dFR1VCN25WSUdOeGdGbzQ5NnU0aHNkdnVqTkFPNTF2VXRBVEVIakRnbUpiVzQtLUJqVmgyVnB3ZjRKUGVIUUtlX1lNNk5UbWZaaWJfeVhLVUJQdG9KYklEczQ4), [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFB0VkFnNHVpNnpWblI1Q1E3cm9JNDNRZmxHbWN2X2I1ZEE5NGxWkhYRVVOSkNaUEdBbE1tR2piM3BIWEczQU9EdlpOZ21BMURNUXVUMkszOFdjVGR6dEE)) signal a push to integrate generative AI into filmmaking, mirroring the DGA's focus on AI protections in the US.

**Watch next:** The Kennedy Center's court-ordered removal of Trump's name ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/trump-kennedy-center-name-removed-1236955117/)) will resolve by early Saturday; the fallout from the Warner Bros-Paramount merger will dominate regulatory and labor discussions; and the Chinese box office will watch whether 'Colony' can sustain its historic pace.

美股.zh:
SpaceX 上市引爆美股情绪，标普、道指上涨，但市场对 AI 泡沫的警告声音渐强。科技股权重过高的结构隐忧浮现。
- [SpaceX 首日涨 19%，市值超 2 万亿美元](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-stock-jumps-2-trillion.html)：散户蜂拥，但部分机构认为估值“stupid”。众议员丈夫因早期投资 xAI 获益。
- [Anthropic 应政府要求屏蔽 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/anthropic-disables-access-to-fable-5-and-mythos-5-to-comply-with-government-directive.html)：首次针对 AI 模型的出口管制，加剧科技股政策不确定性。
- [派拉蒙-WBD 合并获 DOJ 批准](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/paramount-wbd-merger-approval-doj.html)：1100 亿美元交易仍有州级法律风险。
- [Kevin Warsh 坚持“Chairman”头衔](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/fed-kevin-warsh-chairman-title.html)：第一次 FOMC 会议前，市场关注其沟通风格是否会引发波动。
短期看，SpaceX 财富效应有望延续，但若 AI 监管升级或伊朗和谈生变，回调压力不容忽视。
美股.en:
US equities saw a landmark session driven by SpaceX’s bumper IPO, while the Fed transition and AI export controls added crosscurrents. The S&P 500 and Dow edged up as oil slid and SpaceX surged, but tech faced headwinds from model restrictions and valuation concerns.

- **SpaceX IPO frenzy**: Shares closed +19%, market cap above $2 trillion, with retail investors piling in at $135/share ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/spacex-stock-jumps-2-trillion.html)). A House Republican's family investment in xAI pre-merger stands to gain ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/lisa-mcclain-spacex-ipo-xai-investment-congress.html)).
- **Anthropic model restrictions**: US government ordered disabling of Fable 5 & Mythos 5 to foreign nationals, first such AI-specific export control ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/anthropic-disables-access-to-fable-5-and-mythos-5-to-comply-with-government-directive.html)).
- **Paramount-WBD merger approved by DOJ**: $110bn deal clears antitrust hurdle but faces possible state AG challenges ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/paramount-wbd-merger-approval-doj.html)).
- **Fed chair Kevin Warsh**: Warsh prefers 'chairman' title; first meeting will reveal communication style ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/fed-kevin-warsh-chairman-title.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/12/warsh-fed-chair-interest-rates.html)).
- **AI bubble warnings**: TradingKey warns of major correction risk as AI enthusiasm peaks ([TradingKey](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxOWURJWnJrMkt0cjVBX3ltLVV1a3REOUx1ZjBxZXBTYnBlaXlGXzNMeGFPQ3BpX0hPTUFNTTN4eFdiYkpCQm5qaWR2M3ZRTEZ2d2tnTWU4cGpHV3JLR0hDQkVxSUZmWHJZblFkaWpSQXR1czdMZUgzX3lIenZGZXM4aHQzamZpN3dNb2ZoczZCZHJMbEI3QTNMOUNJd2NvSTQyN3M0enpWVzdMckw3OWotMGRLYVdmMERTSEp2d2wtbHA)).

Signal: The IPO euphoria may mask underlying fragility in tech, and the Fed's quiet approach under Warsh could unsettle markets expecting more guidance.

欧洲经济.zh:
ECB 加息 25bp 后市场定价接近“一次即止”，欧元区内部出现分化——德国经济数据疲弱，南欧国家面临更高利率压力。
- [ECB 加息 25bp，专家反应“可能一次即止”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxPTmktM00zN2ktYzZMWkZ4V2Fzdnl6T3ZMQUZEX1hqWFJMQzh2MXh2a0JYdFRTaVh2S0xiM3dmOGEyOFhiQjFERzljUEZ4cHFJdVJKRlYyMXpXRFA4NHV3VUNjYXBmZ0NKdDBTTG54SmJSbU1mbDhwVHVIWE1LTjk0ckc4blFhSHVDaFpGZmY2aEFiLXNKdzJzY21oaDE3b1RVaHQwZndn)：Neuberger 高管称欧洲需要增长计划。
- [欧洲市场为何在 ECB 行动后分裂？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPLU9rVDMwbUdPWDVCX1ZXRVJRVnd4N092N0c5ZXB6aFdRX0ZKaFZSVlhWZ3ZNRzF5b2czZ3JpX3hMV0xNY21UYkUwY21HU1hhVTRWbkRQcURTYzhLMnpEU2kxRXJqQlNFX01YamV0V1BrM2Eya1B3aGZscGtPS1g3RlppS1hYMElYbV9HX0w2NUQzTFM3YURPZEtEZG4zQQ)：Kalkine Media 分析指出，德国出口导向型经济体受影响更大。
- [欧元区能否长期承受更高利率？](https://news.google.)：AllianceBernstein 发出警示。
- [美国消费者信心因油价回落改善，但仍处低位](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/12/consumer-sentiment-june-data-gas-prices)：伊朗战争阴影尚未消散。
ECB 后续行动取决于通胀数据和增长前景，市场对“加息终点”的博弈将主导短期欧元汇率与债券收益率走向。
欧洲经济.en:
The ECB raised rates by 25bp on Friday, sparking debate over whether further tightening is needed amid weak growth. European markets split, with some indexes falling on rate concerns while others gained. US consumer sentiment improved modestly on lower gas prices but remains historically low due to the Iran conflict.

- **ECB rate hike reaction**: A Neuberger executive called it 'probably a one and done', urging Europe to focus on growth ([Business Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxNZDB1bWJFUkdmbkRaSjZ4RFVqM3RsdG5QdzVFYmtlTGZ4cFhqbmxvcktnRFgzMTB4LWZ6VlZLRTZxaU1oQWRoY0tkekdfczJVcHp0QjM4YVE5QVprR2hiWW8yN2RKZXp4YXNyZTFhVkU2ejM5RFlWVFNCZ3lIUXBSR2RUOFpCZWE1ZUwzM3dOSWtMeFJ0SWxFV1N4VDctbGhjR3UwMjRFRVFlTGRjSUUtTU1vVW04RlF2SUFTTTdJSQ)). ING THINK questioned whether rate hikes are pointless given economic weakness ([ING THINK](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1pajM2SUwtZlMtOEZiMEhaLTVDaVFKZ0hCd05aRTlIVDUxOWVWOHhBRC1sVTRJeGFJMWlHS2k1WEhQMXFKYjJTNWRrRldUYlF2eE90VkV5RnNidDZUTWMtcTN3ZGhRNTQzMEtXc01nYTBZVlFCeHpF)).
- **Market divergence**: Why European markets split after the ECB move is analyzed by Kalkine Media ([Kalkine Media](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxPLU9rVDMwbUdPWDVCX1ZXRVJRVnd4N092N0c5ZXB6aFdRX0ZKaFZSVlhWZ3ZNRzF5b2czZ3JpX3hMV0xNY21UYkUwY21HU1hhVTRWbkRQcURTYzhLMnpEU2kxRXJqQlNFX01YamV0V1BrM2Eya1B3aGZscGtPS1g3RlppS1hYMElYbV9HX0w2NUQzTFM3YURPZEtEZG4zQQ)).
- **US consumer sentiment improves**: University of Michigan survey shows easing gas prices lift sentiment, but Iran war and inflation keep levels low ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/12/consumer-sentiment-june-data-gas-prices)).
- **Eurozone rate tolerance**: AllianceBernstein asks whether the Eurozone can tolerate higher rates for long, given fragile conditions ([AllianceBernstein](https://news.google.)).

Signal: The ECB appears near the end of its tightening cycle, but the growth outlook remains bleak; any geopolitical easing (Iran deal) could provide a tailwind for European exporters.

中国经济.zh:
港股遭遇“SpaceX 冲击波”，恒指创 3 月新低。北京强化资本管制，香港监管机构表态配合。大陆芯片设计软件企业押注华为新架构，但追赶美国巨头尚远。
- [香港恒指大跌 437 点至 24,585，亚洲科技股抛售加剧](https://news.google.)：SpaceX 抽血效应与大陆资本外流管控加码形成共振。
- [北京收紧资本管制，香港监管承诺严格合规](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356892/hong-kong-regulators-vow-strict-compliance-beijing-tightens-capital-controls)：证监会主席 Wong 强调“坚守底线”。
- [Amundi CIO：中国市场“便宜得多”，但需警惕海外交易限制](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOZHJmVHNWTHJKQmc2ajdxbDJTU2lJbkdTOXY5RVF3ZDNxamJNa2g4eVQyeWVtR2JodTVRN1BDNk16eGJHdnVpUDFsZTdOWXoxbHNCTi1nb21fQ29xTFJIemVHaWtseFZfWWw0a2VCR0ZuTXYzMGYxcGxfcncwSXRWQWhkdHJPUERtaUd0em9RZE5LTVlrUjRwNGsxXy1JYm14UHZRM0Uza3RJX2pZN0xfNmtwcnBfNGZIWXdWYW96X0l6SUNwbWRZUQ)：外资对 A 股估值认可，但政策风险犹存。
- [华为新芯片架构获 EDA 企业支持，但追赶美国仍艰难](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3356853/chinas-chip-software-firms-back-huaweis-new-scaling-law-can-they-catch-us-rivals)：Empyrean 加入，分析师警告路漫漫。
- [黄金有望年底反弹 13%](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356885/why-gold-may-rebound-13-year-and-what-could-hold-it-back)：央行多元配置及中东和谈预期支撑金价。
短期港股流动性压力较大，但若伊朗和谈取得突破（[上海股市已因和平希望上涨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQVGhsV29reV9nTlhTWmpvbUlROU5WM3BxdjQxYUhXaVZpQXVMc1FtUlVjWmdKUDQ0RWtCMkFTRktaX3VqLXZrdFN0bWpXbURkcDRPNG9jdkl2aUxJTXB3SXNZV0VxR2JUSHQzOGxUYWdTVEF2bTJLSHhGTlJGYmFSQzhrNUpWZw)），可能提振风险偏好。关注 6 月 24 日美联储压力测试结果。
中国经济.en:
China markets faced headwinds from capital control tightening and the SpaceX IPO's liquidity drain on Hong Kong, though Shanghai stocks rallied on Iran peace hopes. The US blocked foreign access to Anthropic's latest AI models, escalating tech tensions. Gold is seen rebounding 13% by year-end on central bank demand.

- **Hong Kong stocks sink**: Hang Seng fell 437 points to 24,585, lowest since March, pressured by Asia tech rout and Beijing's capital control tightening ([BBN Times](https://news.google.)). Regulators vowed strict compliance ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356892/hong-kong-regulators-vow-strict-compliance-beijing-tightens-capital-controls)).
- **SpaceX IPO impact on HK**: The mega-IPO siphons liquidity from Hong Kong, posing a test for the market ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356899/spacex-factor-hong-kong-stocks-face-liquidity-test-mega-ipo)). Mainland Chinese investors' strategies are shifting ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/money/money-news/article/3356873/musk-secures-1st-trillionaire-status-spacex-ipo-will-chinese-tech-see-next-one)).
- **AI model export control**: US blocks foreign access to Anthropic's new models, impacting China's AI ecosystem ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3356990/us-blocks-foreign-access-anthropics-newest-ai-models-over-security-risks)).
- **Gold rebound outlook**: State Street sees gold rising 13% to $4,750–$5,500/oz by year-end on central bank diversification and Middle East hopes ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356885/why-gold-may-rebound-13-year-and-what-could-hold-it-back)).
- **Shanghai stocks rise**: Iran peace hopes boost sentiment, with a possible deal in days ([Modern Diplomacy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQVGhsV29reV9nTlhTWmpvbUlROU5WM3BxdjQxYUhXaVZpQXVMc1FtUlVjWmdKUDQ0RWtCMkFTRktaX3VqLXZrdFN0bWpXbURkcDRPNG9jdkl2aUxJTXB3SXNZV0VxR2JUSHQzOGxUYWdTVEF2bTJLSHhGTlJGYmFSQzhrNUpWZw)).

Signal: Hong Kong's liquidity crunch and capital controls are the dominant risk; a resolution to the Iran conflict could provide a temporary relief rally, but structural tech decoupling remains a drag.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区情绪聚焦 SpaceX 造富神话与境内题材炒作。马斯克登顶万亿富豪成为热搜，同时 A 股游资追逐“8 天 6 板”妖股。AI 相关消息密集：钉钉 AI 管人、华为盘古模型目标“世界第一”、南网储能智能助手。
- [马斯克成为人类首位万亿美元富豪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1wdlJMd01WOGlHZTNlbzZpbVhycXVYRy1SVDk2dXBMb055dEV2VWYtaFJZeDF1LXc1cHdfeDl2Y0YtR3JfU0VaZ2xGZXlka2pKdThlZmVFSTNHVXliYWc)：社区热议财富溢出效应，部分用户担忧散户追高风险。
- [8 天 6 板！603065 最新公告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPTlFXdnlyZHFQNVBVR0xYWUxGN1RnY0VnMDlKN0d2NVlmb3lmVk5ibDd2U0JSSHNPNnNQbFFYRjRnYl84eEZpendMb1RWZ19iWHR1VDI2M2FndnNpTnc)：连板妖股吸引短线资金，公告后分歧加大。
- [陈宇森开启钉钉新时代：让 AI 管人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1Gc2htNllJXzBsWGxNZkFrNEhXZWpTcnVWY2xmMGNfLVFud2NIT0pnMEplRUduTllLRk55akozNHVxS0xEME5yU2poUmxNV1c1b3dPV2QwZzhHZkU3M0E)：AI 落地企业级应用受关注。
- [三安光电控股股东被申请破产重整，单日跌 8.8%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFAyNG1oS1BzNnBpNDNQTTFfWENtSGd6blFYMDRMS001ZXdraUlIYlczNTg3SEQxeTVtbnh4Q0J0c1VSNW9uREFHdkljTmwwLWw3Mm9OUmtpODFVNXJNdkE)：利空发酵，社区讨论是否抄底。
- [海信电视世界杯主题店 10 城联动](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFB5VlJaa0xQVnE2Vjd5ZkgxMU5GdndvaWwwNUZFLUhZZGJjcFhNeFRXUTZoT0pkc2dTTkNZNV9aV2JYbUpXakhQTFF2U1p1UFlfalpJeWxiNWtWMXpTWlE)：消费电子借体育营销刺激。
社区风险偏好两极分化：一边追捧太空概念，一边消化个股爆雷。需关注后续监管对连板炒作的窗口指导。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor forums buzzed with excitement over SpaceX's trillion-dollar milestone and local stock plays. A stock hit six limit-up moves in eight days, while AI and aerospace themes dominated chatter. Key corporate events included Sanan Optoelectronics' controlling shareholder facing bankruptcy restructuring.

- **SpaceX makes Musk trillionaire**: Elon Musk becomes first person worth over $1 trillion; community celebrates with speculative trading ideas ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1wdlJMd01WOGlHZTNlbzZpbVhycXVYRy1SVDk2dXBMb055dEV2VWYtaFJZeDF1LXc1cHdfeDl2Y0YtR3JfU0VaZ2xGZXlka2pKdThlZmVFSTNHVXliYWc)).
- **Eight-day six limit-up stock**: 603065 (unidentified) issued an announcement amid wild volatility ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPTlFXdnlyZHFQNVBVR0xYWUxGN1RnY0VnMDlKN0d2NVlmb3lmVk5ibDd2U0JSSHNPNnNQbFFYRjRnYl84eEZpendMb1RWZ19iWHR1VDI2M2FndnNpTnc)).
- **Aircraft maker hits limit-up**: A leading aircraft manufacturer saw its stock hit the daily ceiling after clarifying rumors ([新浪财经](https://news.google.)).
- **Sanan Optoelectronics plunges 8.8%**: Controlling shareholder's bankruptcy restructuring application spooks investors ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFAyNG1oS1BzNnBpNDNQTTFfWENtSGd6blFYMDRMS001ZXdraUlIYlczNTg3SEQxeTVtbnh4Q0J0c1VSNW9uREFHdkljTmwwLWw3Mm9OUmtpODFVNXJNdkE)).
- **AI and HarmonyOS themes**: Yu Chengdong declares Pangu large model aims to be 'world number one' as HarmonyOS enters Agent era ([同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5fUTJ2VVYzcmVieGlSdjNZTEJkcFJEaFJadWNuVWFPQTI1Vy1ZVjhxTUVCUk9EaGpqdU5QVElwVHFIb282aE9lY3Zhamo2OXFrdFI1bDU2alZuZ2o0SzFMag)).

Signal: Retail sentiment is highly speculative, driven by big winners and AI narratives, but the Sanan bankruptcy case reminds that risk is elevated; watch for regulatory crackdowns on excessive speculation.

欧美.zh:
欧美社会新闻今日聚焦军事、外交与娱乐。特朗普授权击毙委内瑞拉黑帮头目，标志美国对南美跨国犯罪打击升级；伊朗和谈接近尾声或改变中东地缘格局；Jessie J 带病赴华巡演凸显中国市场吸引力。此外，法国儿童谋杀案暴露出警政漏洞。

- 美军在委内瑞拉协助下击毙 Tren de Aragua 头目 Hector Rusthenford Guerrero Flores，特朗普称行动“迅速而致命”（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856611/u-s-military-kill-leader-tren-de-aragua)）。
- 伊朗与美国、巴基斯坦表示停战协议即将达成，霍尔木兹海峡有望重新开放（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c39y02x98k8o)），同日半岛电视台报道英国“巴勒斯坦行动”活动人士因抗议以色列军火公司被判监（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/13/iran-war-live-us-tehran-signal-peace-deal-within-reach-but-not-signed-yet)）。
- Jessie J 宣布癌症痊愈后立即赴中国巡演，分析认为其2018年《歌手》成功打开了西方艺人进入中国市场的窗口（[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/13/jessie-j-lucrative-chinese-market-westlife-charli-xcx)）。
- 法国11岁女孩 Lyhanna 遭谋杀，嫌疑人此前曾被举报但未被警方讯问，社区愤怒要求追责（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy9rq21dqego)）。
- 西班牙前首相 José Luis Rodriguez Zapatero 因价值120万欧元珠宝无法证明完税而被重新调查（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjeg9p1xqdwo)）。

欧美近期多条线索显示：外交与安全政策趋于激进，但社会信任问题（警方失职、腐败司法）同样在发酵。
欧美.en:
The European and American desks highlight a mix of geopolitical strikes, cultural losses, and World Cup tensions. The US military's targeted killing of a Venezuelan gang leader with Caracas's cooperation marks an unusual bilateral counter-crime operation. Meanwhile, Iran-US peace talks are close to a deal that could reopen the Hormuz strait, but remain unsigned. In culture, David Hockney's death at 88 and Taylor Swift's induction into the Songwriters Hall of Fame drew widespread tributes. The World Cup continues to generate headlines: Fifa says empty seats were due to fans on concourses, and Iran's team faces unique political pressures as it prepares to play on US soil.

- US military kills Tren de Aragua leader in joint operation with Venezuela. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/12/nx-s1-5856611/u-s-military-kill-leader-tren-de-aragua) | [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/12/trump-venezuela-tren-de-aragua-leader-killed)
- Iran peace deal near: US, Iran, Pakistan signal imminent agreement to end fighting and reopen Hormuz. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c39y02x98k8o) | [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/13/iran-war-live-us-tehran-signal-peace-deal-within-reach-but-not-signed-yet)
- David Hockney dies at 88; King Charles leads tributes. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgjxdr27z4o)
- Taylor Swift becomes youngest woman inducted into Songwriters Hall of Fame with tearful speech. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5yzxd0g833o)
- World Cup: Iran set to play New Zealand in Los Angeles amid war with host nation; flag bans and travel issues. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/12/iran-first-play-war-world-cup-fifa)

Watch for the evolving Iran deal and its ripple effects on energy markets, and the cultural impact of Hockney's legacy on art institutions.

日韩.zh:
日韩社会新闻以世界杯情绪、社交媒体风险和知识产权保护为主线。韩国队世界杯险胜捷克引发全民狂欢，日本队备战高期待；日本社交媒体咨询量首次破10万，反映数字社会隐忧；一名从日本引渡至韩国的男子因运营盗版漫画网站获利被捕，凸显跨境版权执法力度。

- 韩国队在世界杯小组赛对阵捷克中凭借出色门将和双射手惊险获胜，韩国媒体称其为“英雄”（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9LVWpoVko2TElDbjFYNUpERm5WNURXN3pVUmFHeGpIVS1lRHMxQUxkTWxuaUl2UUhWOVZiZzh0eDZLeHpEOW1oaGJ4cmVuQ1UwSWhQajRyRQ)）。
- 日本消费者关于社交媒体的投诉与咨询首次突破10万件，涉及网络诈骗、隐私泄露等（[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQM1BaMmVJTms4MnoxZ05UMGN6b0ptZXg1Sl9sQUJMTElxSnY0SThNN1FLaTZtY1FPeFRiZzl5amlQaW1Ucmo4eEVyWWw4Mnd4V1VlczNqX2JPTy1vRVk1ODZaTlNqSXFoMWxmbVFrWER0aHZsV0IzcHVBeTJYalJORTlEOGRWVVpOV2t0cmtUclBTYnM)）。
- 一名男子从日本被引渡至韩国，涉嫌运营大型盗版漫画分享网站，通过《海贼王》等作品非法获利（[The Japan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBUaG9XVDJ2b2tkLWNKaWJ0NGNaSGtiT3QwbHJ1SEI1NmRjeE1TM3RsWjR6bGNsMy0wamdRZVlrSWdJNGV6Q25nRUYxM29KUkowQW00WU1JcWhGY2lQYVV0NzZqN1RhOXU2SkZWeFZRWjUyZjRHOVl0YQ)）。
- 近40%的日本老年人希望继续工作，反映少子老龄化下的劳动力缺口与社会态度变化（[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPeWFBSWs3UXBWaUo3dU1lWkpWNVFoaW03dE1JY1dnQzQ4Z0l0a0hIeVg3eWFLSDZXNWdxTXZ6RDk0aU1TT1AtZXZhWXM4Q3FVSmZxN0hDc0VhaWFQRGhYZmk2Y3BXOURSUHREUVFENDZ2eDVJV1R3N0FQYUpnaEJkZg)）。
- 日本一项研究警告，对食品消费税减税可能弊大于利（[The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxNSld0MW1pbnRZaXFWZlhBNWsxZVV6akNycUptSnRYalVDcDRtT2pQa25lSHdadElQVkJ2Vk5UVk5CY3dGZHl4VXFkOTVIWXNGM2pqa2xhYVdjQi1OOF9QUXNDZ2dLWmlnNnJEamFXOW5vaFIzQl9mWUR1TGdvMThBaDk0UXNrUElNaHhPNTFoX2JzLTFu)）。

日韩社会在世界杯狂欢之余，必须直面数字治理、老龄化与版权保护的结构性挑战。
日韩.en:
Japan and Korea desks show a mix of social media debates, World Cup excitement, and cross-border legal actions. A viral incident where a grandmother scolded a woman for eating in a park has sparked a generational debate about public manners in Japan. In sports, South Korea's thrilling World Cup win over the Czech Republic made heroes of two scorers and a goalkeeper, while Japan aims to meet high expectations. Legal news: a man was extradited from Japan to South Korea for allegedly operating illegal manga-sharing sites. Separately, consumer consultations about social media in Japan have topped 100,000 for the first time, reflecting growing online harms.

- Viral park eating incident fuels intergenerational debate in Japan. [TOY PEOPLE](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE9oLUlZS0czRG53dm9maFU0Z3BNMk80cGZVMjkzRXQtVnRhYmVzc2gzTXNyNkc5MENadjJnQlFvZzNxaURFV1g5bXVRSzZHRmxH)
- South Korea's World Cup heroes: two scorers and a standout goalkeeper lead thrilling win over Czech Republic. [Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9LVWpoVko2TElDbjFYNUpERm5WNURXN3pVUmFHeGpIVS1lRHMxQUxkTWxuaUl2UUhWOVZiZzh0eDZLeHpEOW1oaGJ4cmVuQ1UwSWhQajRyRQ)
- Man extradited from Japan to South Korea for operating illegal manga-sharing sites, profiting from 'One Piece'. [The Japan News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBUaG9XVDJ2b2tkLWNKaWJ0NGNaSGtiT3QwbHJ1SEI1NmRjeE1TM3RsWjR6bGNsMy0wamdRZVlrSWdJNGV6Q25nRUYxM29KUkowQW00WU1JcWhGY2lQYVV0NzZqN1RhOXU2SkZWeFZRWjUyZjRHOVl0YQ)
- Japan consumer consultations about social media hit record 100,000, highlighting rising online issues. [The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQM1BaMmVJTms4MnoxZ05UMGN6b0ptZXg1Sl9sQUJMTElxSnY0SThNN1FLaTZtY1FPeFRiZzl5amlQaW1Ucmo4eEVyWWw4Mnd4V1VlczNqX2JPTy1vRVk1ODZaTlNqSXFoMWxmbVFrWER0aHZsV0IzcHVBeTJYalJORTlEOGRWVVpOV2t0cmtUclBTYnM)
- Nearly 40% of older adults in Japan want to keep working, signaling labor market shifts. [The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPeWFBSWs3UXBWaUo3dU1lWkpWNVFoaW03dE1JY1dnQzQ4Z0l0a0hIeVg3eWFLSDZXNWdxTXZ6RDk0aU1TT1AtZXZhWXM4Q3FVSmZxN0hDc0VhaWFQRGhYZmk2Y3BXOURSUHREUVFENDZ2eDVJV1R3N0FQYUpnaEJkZg)

Watch for further generational friction in Japan around public etiquette and the potential for new regulations on social media platforms.

中国.zh:
中国社会新闻今日亮点集中在 AI 技术突破、教育议题与医疗援外。国内 AI 模型在基准测试中反超 GPT-5.5，被视为自主创新的标志性事件；基础教育论坛探讨高质量发展；援外医疗队创新传播路径。此外，古巴在美方压力下的应对措施也获中方报道。

- 新浪财经报道称，中国纯血 AI 模型在多项基准测试中反超 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.5，引发国内对自主技术突破的热议（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNd1FHQmR6T0RZQnNBbXNoWVhqcThJUkpfRUNOWXI4bmwyLTBMbjBWaHkwc1I3S0c4ay1YR0EyajlOazZyeTdBSTZnNXN3TDRJamxBd1NVdUdZWE9LOFgzWEtqcThlOG1lQWNzZEt2dVdYUnZQTUZ1bm1iZ0ZwQ3FJeTFqWU1XMGgtU09SOG5UNU9XWXF0M1VzZ2V2V1l3T25XR2RfUmNzbHpGakR6VDNISXBR)）。
- 第四届“中国基础教育高质量发展·北京论坛”在朝阳举办，聚焦教育公平与质量提升（[京报网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE11ZWpOTUltMl9oMjJ1UWlYSzdSVHFkcFRWUkNxTkhxdUNoTnJEZFZubDBRNndpMWZVU3BIQ1VvdGlaajZhY2J0aXlNQXFvRnZpV0VIZWQ5eEFiWkxLQWc)）。
- AI 通识课落地路径引发专家热议，呼吁将课堂打造成“问题的孵化器”（[新京报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5uUEhQeW5lbHV4NHRrdHI3WElNRXBYenRWVWtxUC1fVWdueGlKTVhYRjJ2Y2I5TTMtUnZycVMyVXVDRnZkMnZERFlMWVVDWlRaMUwyQWp2UWFPUEY0cHphYUF2eWg)）。
- 援几内亚中国医疗队通过屏幕传播健康知识，探索远程医疗新路径（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwUU9aMjQyQlpUcGQyMXZPSEdSS0VWMk9EZ3RrWUs1MW1BVHVxUTVVNENvQl9LWU5iN0xFdkJxM0xuNGdXT2ptd0diOFZKV1Y4dHgxUW5oanYzRUdXN2Nad2ZtVk5PbURad1BZQm1tQ3hmeHJFOUF0U2ZnMUtvQQ)）。
- 古巴确定系列举措应对美国极限施压，中方媒体给予关注（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBSMzF5NW13WU5PQnE2OFQ4VEtTWTk1YzZxbjlEWmtWU0FSa1lYTnF3UE5SMTlzQldNR3pxd3Azak1wMlNERGx4c0ZfYUF4LWtPcG1hbFVXakxmc2RpZFpqRV9KUC14UXdGWEZuQ1VXNUFwRDNYWjlMd2hGQzRhQQ)）。

中国社会新闻在强调自主科技、教育革新与国际责任的同时，外媒关于“间谍动物”的指控（[The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/12/china-spy-turtles-spy-fish-monitor-waters-claims)）形成对比，需注意不同叙事框架。
中国.en:
China's domestic news focuses on AI advances, education reforms, and diplomatic health outreach. A Chinese AI model reportedly surpassed GPT-5.5 in benchmarks, marking a significant milestone in the country's tech race. Education forums and university leadership changes (Li Jian appointed president of Jiangnan University) dominate institutional news. The medical aid team in Guinea and China's expanding healthcare exports to ASEAN highlight soft power efforts. Economic data shows social financing aggregate rose 7.7% year-on-year to 458.81 trillion yuan, indicating steady credit expansion.

- Chinese AI model overtakes GPT-5.5, signaling competitive leap in global AI. [Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNd1FHQmR6T0RZQnNBbXNoWVhqcThJUkpfRUNOWXI4bmwyLTBMbjBWaHkwc1I3S0c4ay1YR0EyajlOazZyeTdBSTZnNXN3TDRJamxBd1NVdUdZWE9LOFgzWEtqcThlOG1lQWNzZEt2dVdYUnZQTUZ1bm1iZ0ZwQ3FJeTFqWU1XMGgtU09SOG5UNU9XWXF0M1VzZ2V2V1l3T25XR2RfUmNzbHpGakR6VDNISXBR)
- Li Jian appointed president of Jiangnan University, part of broader education leadership reshuffles. [China Education News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9QaTlFSS1iOFpITmNfbnNPcElEU1V2Y1ZWbjVjc1BlRlF3UmR3WXBja01fdVY2Uk93M0NLVTFTVm44azl4aFoweklwZWZuekhRblViM3dOWUtMMDJGTWNDMlczRGlQVGpUSDJF)
- China's medical aid to Guinea and healthcare exports to ASEAN reflect growing soft power. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFAwUU9aMjQyQlpUcGQyMXZPSEdSS0VWMk9EZ3RrWUs1MW1BVHVxUTVVNENvQl9LWU5iN0xFdkJxM0xuNGdXT2ptd0diOFZKV1Y4dHgxUW5oanYzRUdXN2Nad2ZtVk5PbURad1BZQm1tQ3hmeHJFOUF0U2ZnMUtvQQ) | [China News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1PTFFWRjhYa3VjTTlWSXZiNHRfMjBZZ2RiMzJYRkNMSDEzaG12bXB3NUVBdGtDNWRvcGxVQU1IbGs3UFk0SHdYOC1SOVdIQU1IWlR3dkJXb2xaQjcwaGxZMk51OVdwYXZNUEhieTcyRFA1UQ)
- Social financing stock reaches 458.81 trillion yuan, up 7.7% YoY, reflecting ongoing credit growth. [China News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9jd0NsWFhmRGROTDYzcEh2a2Rfby1sRnJVVndzT3llSHhSTTJndEZhME8yd1YtNGVRRi1qb1lIZy1BU0V2SE90ZlRqNW1saVIxLVFKMDQxMmpmU0l6ZHNPQ25rbXd6eWJf)
- Education forums on AI general education and industry-education integration highlight policy priorities. [Beijing News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE11ZWpOTUltMl9oMjJ1UWlYSzdSVHFkcFRWUkNxTkhxdUNoTnJEZFZubDBRNndpMWZVU3BIQ1VvdGlaajZhY2J0aXlNQXFvRnZpV0VIZWQ5eEFiWkxKQWc) | [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBEblFzVVFqMUFXNFVWTmpUMmt1OFFEeEZ0NzZsQ0lqQTFYejZ4Umt5STR4WGZ4bDZuUXBueGZJOEJGRFg3QnNDNmFDRll4QTdaMW8tcWwxaWhYam1RU0p5b2xPcjJWdkxiZFlR)

Watch for potential US/China AI technology export controls following this latest benchmark claim.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区今日两条热议：一是《女心理师》豆瓣评分仅5.1但获心理专业人士认可，引发对大众评价与专业视角分歧的讨论；二是实测知乎搜索技能（Skill）功能，认为免费且实用。这两条分别触及内容评价标准与平台功能迭代。

- 《女心理师》评分争议：豆瓣用户给出低分，但心理专业人士指出剧集对心理问题的呈现相当专业，分歧源于娱乐性与科普性的不同期待（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQQVo1YWd6ZkxxcmdfVHN0d1BBRUpiZ2t3elhSUXhpckZzbHB6ajhVWml6dUd5U0RVRTBJSW51WWkwSVZ1d1F3ejVERHZxTXNsM3h1LTNfcDBlSnYyNnhKcWRHRHFXNlVUdGdsR1kwcEJXR3BfVEdveE9DTFNyVW5VSA)）。
- 知乎搜索 Skill 实测：第三方评测认为该功能免费且效果不错，或有助于提升用户体验（[53AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1xaUd4QnRHeVFlalpVT0xnMVp6OFNDTG1XUHMtamc4WlN3NXFvaF9VdEEyQU5ZYXoxZUpoWUlrdVNHRWhUNjJ0cWhfY1NiaWpITnR6SzY5Q0JUM3dpVUZlUDd5R3VOV0VIVWc)）。

知乎社区动态虽少，但折射出平台内对内容品质的持续争论以及自身产品的低调迭代。后续可关注更多社区原生产品上线后的用户反馈。
知乎社区动态.en:
Two items emerge from Zhihu community dynamics. A discussion around the drama "The Female Psychologist" (《女心理师》) reveals a major disconnect: the show has a low Douban score of 5.1, yet psychology professionals give it high marks, sparking debate about audience versus expert expectations. Separately, tests of Zhihu's new search Skill feature find it surprisingly effective and free, potentially positioning it against paid AI search tools.

- "The Female Psychologist" ratings split: Douban 5.1 vs professional approval, fueling analysis of differing standards. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQQVo1YWd6ZkxxcmdfVHN0d1BBRUpiZ2t3elhSUXhpckZzbHB6ajhVWml6dUd5U0RVRTBJSW51WWkwSVZ1d1F3ejVERHZxTXNsM3h1LTNfcDBlSnYyNnhKcWRHRHFXNlVUdGdsR1kwcEJXR3BfVEdveE9DTFNyVW5VSA)
- Zhihu's search Skill tested: free and capable, challenging paid AI tools. [53AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1xaUd4QnRHeVFlalpVT0xnMVp6OFNDTG1XUHMtamc4WlN3NXFvaF9VdEEyQU5ZYXoxZUpoWUlrdVNHRWhUNjJ0cWhfY1NiaWpITnR6SzY5Q0JUM3dpVUZlUDd5R3VOV0VIVWc)

Watch for continued user engagement around Zhihu's AI features and whether the drama rating debate influences production decisions.

国际安全.zh:
美伊冲突持续主导国际安全议程，美军A-10攻击机从战场直飞英国，机身涂满任务标记；F-35战备率下滑至25%引发国会关注；俄罗斯在北极加速部署、北约组建新部队应对。
- 美军A-10攻击机在“史诗愤怒”行动后抵达英国，任务标记展示其在伊朗战场的实际行动。[A-10](https://www.twz.com/air/a-10-warthogs-arrive-in-england-festooned-with-nose-art-and-mission-markings-from-epic-fury)
- GAO报告：F-35机队2025财年“完全任务能力”率仅25%，军方需大幅提升备战水平。[F-35](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/06/12/only-1-in-4-f-35s-is-fully-mission-capable-gao-finds/)
- 俄罗斯沿北约北翼建设大型军事设施，北约组建北极作战部队作为反制。[北极](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russia-building-new-infrastructure-for-major-troop-deployments-along-natos-northern-flank)
- 欧洲六代机项目失和：德国与西班牙启动“Team Gen 6”，法国、意大利、英国各有盘算。[六代机](https://www.twz.com/air/germany-and-spain-launch-team-gen-6-after-europes-next-gen-fighter-effort-collapses)
- 美国国会试图恢复4架U-2S侦察机，阻止空军退役“龙女”机队。[U-2](https://www.twz.com/air/four-u-2s-spy-planes-would-be-restored-in-bill-that-would-save-the-dragon-lady-fleet)

**判断**：美军现役装备的可靠性（F-35）与老旧平台（A-10、U-2）的实战价值形成鲜明对比，资源分配争议将进一步激化。
国际安全.en:
The international security landscape is defined by the ongoing Iran conflict, US force readiness challenges, and new flashpoints in the Arctic and Europe. A GAO report reveals the F-35 fleet's full mission capable rate has dropped to 25%, raising serious concerns about US air dominance ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/06/12/only-1-in-4-f-35s-is-fully-mission-capable-gao-finds/)). Meanwhile, Russia is constructing infrastructure to support mass troop deployments along NATO’s northern flank, prompting NATO to create an Arctic combat force ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russia-building-new-infrastructure-for-major-troop-deployments-along-natos-northern-flank)). Germany and Spain have launched 'Team Gen 6' after the European next-generation fighter program collapsed, potentially splitting European defense industrial cooperation ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/germany-and-spain-launch-team-gen-6-after-europes-next-gen-fighter-effort-collapses)).

- **F-35 Readiness Crisis**: Only 25% of F-35s are fully mission capable, per GAO, with rates declining through FY2025 ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/industry/techwatch/2026/06/12/only-1-in-4-f-35s-is-fully-mission-capable-gao-finds/)).
- **Russia-NATO Arctic Buildup**: Russia building facilities for tens of thousands of troops; NATO responds with a new deterrent force ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/russia-building-new-infrastructure-for-major-troop-deployments-along-natos-northern-flank)).
- **European Fighter Split**: Germany and Spain form 'Team Gen 6' after EU next-gen fighter collapses ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/germany-and-spain-launch-team-gen-6-after-europes-next-gen-fighter-effort-collapses)).
- **UAE Deploys South Korean Missile Shield**: Eight C-17s airlift M-SAM-II to Gulf amid Hormuz blockade ([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQQUdjNGMyeEx3S0RzeWdrdldQeVdkeHo1cUZZbXZtRWREd2ZjSGNyQlJkOWhaX2YxNHZGc0hBVG9LY0U0NGhsd2lVRFUtUlBuQ2o4c3FlLVZEenl1YmUtckxsLVNfWTFQZkRtWEJZd1Z5NWR1NXhPMDFLSm1sZ2tOMGpURG5hcXVyOUlNS0FSZFYzbGtzZm9IX2pwT0ZkVk8yZmpRag)).
- **THAAD Success & Depletion**: THAAD intercepts 90% of Iranian missiles, but US stocks are running low ([19FortyFive](https://news.google.)).

**Signal**: The combination of F-35 readiness failures, THAAD depletion, and the Arctic/Russian build-up suggests the US and NATO face simultaneous capacity pressures that could reshape defense priorities.

冲突局势.zh:
伊朗战争的经济后果开始显现：航运成本翻倍、全球经济或损失2.2万亿美元。外交层面，意大利和波兰不满被排除在乌克兰和平谈判之外，土耳其强调结束乌克兰战争对黑海安全至关重要。
- 研究报告警告伊朗战争可能给全球经济带来2.2万亿美元损失，航运和能源首当其冲。[经济成本](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQNzU4a2hoY0JGZXoteXl5SEdaYzlGWHgyX2Z4amxfRllMSDJNWVNNMmMxVmIyMTR3bEhmdDdYTWdBLUp0T1hqbU1kVloySENUNkdrbmxuS3VyYnhzU3pNWXlVUnhUM3RRRGFvOWRnN09pZFdkUmV4WDhLSDlnMTE3U256M3FfSEZMdmtyREpfRWxvTURGZDMzSVhUck51b0k)
- 全球集装箱运价因伊朗霍尔木兹海峡封锁飙升超100%，燃油成本暴涨。[航运](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxNa3RsREYydTNRS00tcVJOSHlsZVBDU3lmcHJ2MGpFS0hhbHNMM0NPZnhxdHhhWDlfZWhFZWJSUllPamdUVGxUd0NUQXpUV2Nxa2NFU25fUFNhMTFTa1BYTXV6NmhGcXZjY1dfS1E1TXI2UmdIdmNXb2kyWHlBTXlWczRpTEljLWdERXRwUnFiQjgxZHNIQmtBMXZLM09wekVnMWFaNmZEV0dNc1ZhRmlLMkRLb3g)
- 阿联酋紧急空运韩国“天弓-II”防空系统至前线，应对伊朗导弹威胁。[UAE](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxQQUdjNGMyeEx3S0RzeWdrdldQeVdkeHo1cUZZbXZtRWREd2ZjSGNyQlJkOWhaX2YxNHZGc0hBVG9LY0U0NGhsd2lVRFUtUlBuQ2o4c3FlLVZEenl1YmUtckxsLVNfWTFQZkRtWEJZd1Z5NWR1NXhPMDFLSm1sZ2tOMGpURG5hcXVyOUlNS0FSZFYzbGtzZm9IX2pwT0ZkVk8yZmpRag)
- 意大利和波兰批评被排除在乌克兰和平谈判之外，俄罗斯外长拉夫罗夫访伊引起关注。[意大利波兰](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQSEFRTVVTczJlZXNTVUZfcmtPMUI1eDBlSkFiZ2hPa1hKMUFEajBpYzRGa3VWTUpjdndKR2p6Mks1a0p4aDhJWTJnSF93cFZhSEQ3YzNnUFo5cC1VeTdhRURvcWRuZ2tmeUxHSGNmMTU1TjhXd0hzcDB1cmJHTEVaS1JNcDhYeDYxUV96QlRwb0hQS2h1bkJ1SExnMVM)
