冲突局势.en:
The Iran war's economic toll is mounting with global container shipping rates soaring over 100% and fuel costs surging, while a peace report warns of a potential $2.2 trillion cost to the global economy ([Gulf Business](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQNzU4a2hoY0JGZXoteXl5SEdaYzlGWHgyX2Z4amxfRllMSDJNWVNNMmMxVmIyMTR3bEhmdDdYTWdBLUp0T1hqbU1kVloySENUNkdrbmxuS3VyYnhzU3pNWXlVUnhUM3RRRGFvOWRnN09pZFdkUmV4WDhLSDlnMTE3U256M3FfSEZMdmtyREpfRWxvTURGZDMzSVhUck51b0k)). Three seafarers were killed in a Hormuz strike, and the UN warns of widening fallout ([The European Sting](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOZDZhcjE2Z0RvOEVuREVPYjZsaWR2UVhKbmtVZ2RDaGRfNUlackIyYjY0cmpWQzR0dEY2UjlnMldGdnI1ajV6VTcxdjctQ0hOcjh1YUJuaWdvT1U2aGxKeXFKYnNXaUVrOVpjeGpLdkxGaklrNzVGeUljbDRwcWZvTGx2OUprWlBVT3hIX08wN2d0eml3TXBERmMtbE54NGNHSElXcWpFeVJyOTlfclE)). Analysts weigh whether Israel is driving the US toward endless conflict with Iran ([Middle East Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNbjgzRmNxemNObmlNd3QybHR2SXBac1NsZGRWalo5M1RVaUl1LVdtUjBIZnV3bDhySjNCcU02VUc2RkJrMVFMQXRrWWxmYzh5anZ6RHlkX2xaMVVTVTA0ajViSnFpanpxUzNVbXVsSWdZS0U0VUc2LW9GUGlkZUQ2c2lvUndlM3YxWVBzZHBuc1lrWndQM2ttcW4teEFZRkUxOXBzWA)). Meanwhile, Turkey states ending the Ukraine war is essential for Black Sea security ([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE9EbEh0VHZNM1pjZDZkVnpWNnNtY0ZnTGZDV2N3WEIzREZhLU9hUEhoT0MzWjVROERoRlhuOTNyMWVkQ1dWM28zc0xldw)), and Italy and Poland criticize exclusion from Ukraine peace talks ([AnewZ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQSEFRTVVTczJlZXNTVUZfcmtPMUI1eDBlSkFiZ2hPa1hKMUFEajBpYzRGa3VWTUpjdndKR2p6Mks1a0p4aDhJWTJnSF93cFZhSEQ3YzNnUFo5cC1VeTdhRURvcWRuZ2tmeUxHSGNmMTU1TjhXd0hzcDB1cmJHTEVaS1JNcDhYeDYxUV96QlRwb0hQS2h1bkJ1SExnMVM)). Houthi resumption of Red Sea campaign could trigger a general escalation ([Yahoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxQOVlqUTVWNmpYRjZZV2JlODlqQ1JqQnF1RTk0aGpaNlgzakNTT0RqTm13WjVhUVh4ckg1anIydkZId09aS2NDNWNXNHcxck12VDVvTUVtUDhsRDRRQ3pzVVNpQUxadDVMeV9ScHlwODVrT0J4eXcwVUJ2ZHJkQk9ZSExndUFzc282cFo3Wnp0UUE4N1BaSHlEZldJaEFMUQ)).

- **Economic Shock**: Shipping rates double, fuel costs surge; peace report estimates $2.2tn global cost ([Gulf Business](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQNzU4a2hoY0JGZXoteXl5SEdaYzlGWHgyX2Z4amxfRllMSDJNWVNNMmMxVmIyMTR3bEhmdDdYTWdBLUp0T1hqbU1kVloySENUNkdrbmxuS3VyYnhzU3pNWXlVUnhUM3RRRGFvOWRnN09pZFdkUmV4WDhLSDlnMTE3U256M3FfSEZMdmtyREpfRWxvTURGZDMzSVhUck51b0k)).
- **Human Cost**: Three seafarers killed in Hormuz strike; UN warns of widening fallout ([The European Sting](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxOZDZhcjE2Z0RvOEVuREVPYjZsaWR2UVhKbmtVZ2RDaGRfNUlackIyYjY0cmpWQzR0dEY2UjlnMldGdnI1ajV6VTcxdjctQ0hOcjh1YUJuaWdvT1U2aGxKeXFKYnNXaUVrOVpjeGpLdkxGaklrNzVGeUljbDRwcWZvTGx2OUprWlBVT3hIX08wN2d0eml3TXBERmMtbE54NGNHSElXcWpFeVJyOTlfclE)).
- **Israel's Role**: Debate over whether Israel is driving US toward endless conflict with Iran ([Middle East Online](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNbjgzRmNxemNObmlNd3QybHR2SXBac1NsZGRWalo5M1RVaUl1LVdtUjBIZnV3bDhySjNCcU02VUc2RkJrMVFMQXRrWWxmYzh5anZ6RHlkX2xaMVVTVTA0ajViSnFpanpxUzNVbXVsSWdZS0U0VUc2LW9GUGlkZUQ2c2lvUndlM3YxWVBzZHBuc1lrWndQM2ttcW4teEFZRkUxOXBzWA)).
- **Ukraine Peace Talks Splinter**: Italy, Poland criticize exclusion; Turkey links Ukraine war to Black Sea security ([AnewZ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQSEFRTVVTczJlZXNTVUZfcmtPMUI1eDBlSkFiZ2hPa1hKMUFEajBpYzRGa3VWTUpjdndKR2p6Mks1a0p4aDhJWTJnSF93cFZhSEQ3YzNnUFo5cC1VeTdhRURvcWRuZ2tmeUxHSGNmMTU1TjhXd0hzcDB1cmJHTEVaS1JNcDhYeDYxUV96QlRwb0hQS2h1bkJ1SExnMVM), [Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE9EbEh0VHZNM1pjZDZkVnpWNnNtY0ZnTGZDV2N3WEIzREZhLU9hUEhoT0MzWjVROERoRlhuOTNyMWVkQ1dWM28zc0xldw)).

**Watch next**: If Houthis resume Red Sea attacks, insurance and shipping costs could spike further, amplifying global inflation pressures and potentially drawing in more naval forces.

中国军情.zh:
美中军事摩擦持续升温：美国会议员提案禁止中国军方关联企业员工入境，中国商务部回应“罔顾中美元首共识”。中国海军在南海和日本方向进行针对性演习，同时恢复对舰炮的重视引发外界关注。
- 美国跨党派议员提案：禁止中国军方关联企业员工入境并驱逐在美人员，涉及范围扩大。[提案](https://news.google.)
- 中国商务部回应：批美“罔顾中美元首共识，无视经贸关系大局”。[商务部](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE12aUoyTnZUQ0VOM09HdlNXM3IycE9iRzhsLXFVTUhtSGZOOTc4RWZRTUxBZ2RxUGFRWFViS2FGd0lDV0JibUx4Nml5eFZ0elR6MVV3cWUtZ3cwNTg5MjhzVmlsQWRkOHlWR3c)
- 南华早报分析：中国海军正在重新装备大口径舰炮，在导弹和无人机时代“回归传统”，旨在近海威慑和成本控制。[舰炮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPWDdKbzlPT0JhVzhibDZwMTNvMkNkTHRKbjVRRzlVZy12SzFxVjdUQkk2LXd3UE1iWTE0ZWVpZDlBMS1JN1l0X1BuaFVwRWJ3YlFYZlctbTJ5cTNLSTktLU51Z00xWnVNYldyUU1TQ2twYkxKTWVFUEFUbE93TGIwQS1kbTdhbnk2cUxjeEM1SFNVMmNmUFVCcUd4SFlZX0dmRFRLalZGRjJCM1BraHc4YTZiSjJnV2Nra0llUkpZNA)
- 朝日新闻报道：中国针对“假想敌”日本进行军事演习，演习规模与针对性显著提升。[演习](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOR01MMFhveU1rTHROV0JNc013R0l6ajAxVUlCMFNmdXQxQ2RaZDJ3WFExa0M3Mk93aUp1YUxoV01odUppaEw4VldyMHVuNGN1SkFjejFGN1p3djZvTFl6S0pqekwwMWhEQWZrckZMRE0tUzNVdTBvYWF1d0lmckJJa1BwbVRPNk5IUUFFLS1IS1R2b2ZuS3JBNw)
- 台媒：美军拟在澳大利亚西海岸新建核潜艇支援基地，瞄准中国南海。[澳基地](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPSHJzc09fWWNvcmlkRWI5bEtaX2Z5UmUyNENoUlNsaUZaajdQZjkzaXZya0tUSGxIdzctUTVvTGVyQ2tYaDBsYUFoVWs0WVlKbDVhVkh5TVFiTTVCcEpiWUQtN0s1bVZRMWhxMHJxbk1zQS1pVFlkdDU1N2kzQ3NMTjcwMW1NU2VvbFNlbQ)

**判断**：美中军事与科技对抗正从企业清单向人员流动领域延伸，两国关系在伊朗战争背景下更趋复杂。
中国军情.en:
China is intensifying military and diplomatic pressure on multiple fronts. The PLA Navy has conducted exercises with Japan as a designated 'mock enemy,' signaling a hardening posture toward Tokyo ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOR01MMFhveU1rTHROV0JNc013R0l6ajAxVUlCMFNmdXQxQ2RaZDJ3WFExa0M3Mk93aUp1YUxoV01odUppaEw4VldyMHVuNGN1SkFjejFGN1p3djZvTFl6S0pqekwwMWhEQWZrckZMRE0tUzNVdTBvYWF1d0lmckJJa1BwbVRPNk5IUUFFLS1IS1R2b2ZuS3JBNw)). The US is moving to establish a new nuclear submarine support base on Australia's west coast, aimed at the South China Sea ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPSHJzc09fWWNvcmlkRWI5bEtaX2Z5UmUyNENoUlNsaUZaajdQZjkzaXZya0tUSGxIdzctUTVvTGVyQ2tYaDBsYUFoVWs0WVlKbDVhVkh5TVFiTTVCcEpiWUQtN0s1bVZRMWhxMHJxbk1zQS1pVFlkdDU1N2kzQ3NMTjcwMW1NU2VvbFNlbQ)). Meanwhile, China's Ministry of Commerce criticized the US for placing Chinese companies on its 'China Military Enterprise' list, accusing Washington of ignoring bilateral consensus ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9mMUhFem1tQV9yWldpd2VBbkZhMk1HNjZWQ1hhMktMX0VVTTBuczFUdS14dmFKN2ZXNmstYmZ4RHRBOWVCeS04SEhjVDZLTUxUUXhJRGxWZXlRdFhrVVAzOWdOZHBFTnUzUUJwNDZFTkpuMUVLTWdv)). US lawmakers have also proposed banning employees of Chinese military-linked firms from entering the US and deporting those already in the country ([VOA](https://news.google.)). Wuxi Pharmatech (WuXi AppTec) has filed a lawsuit against the US Department of Defense over its designation as a military-linked firm, challenging the legal foundation of such listings ([VOA](https://news.google.)).

- **Military Exercises**: PLA Navy drills with Japan as mock enemy, signaling strategic competition ([Chosun Ilbo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOR01MMFhveU1rTHROV0JNc013R0l6ajAxVUlCMFNmdXQxQ2RaZDJ3WFExa0M3Mk93aUp1YUxoV01odUppaEw4VldyMHVuNGN1SkFjejFGN1p3djZvTFl6S0pqekwwMWhEQWZrckZMRE0tUzNVdTBvYWF1d0lmckJJa1BwbVRPNk5IUUFFLS1IS1R2b2ZuS3JBNw)).
- **US Australia Sub Base**: New US nuclear submarine support base on Australia's west coast to counter China in South China Sea ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPSHJzc09fWWNvcmlkRWI5bEtaX2Z5UmUyNENoUlNsaUZaajdQZjkzaXZya0tUSGxIdzctUTVvTGVyQ2tYaDBsYUFoVWs0WVlKbDVhVkh5TVFiTTVCcEpiWUQtN0s1bVZRMWhxMHJxbk1zQS1pVFlkdDU1N2kzQ3NMTjcwMW1NU2VvbFNlbQ)).
- **US Sanctions & Lists**: China criticizes US 'military enterprise' list; Commerce Ministry says it disregards bilateral consensus ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9mMUhFem1tQV9yWldpd2VBbkZhMk1HNjZWQ1hhMktMX0VVTTBuczFUdS14dmFKN2ZXNmstYmZ4RHRBOWVCeS04SEhjVDZLTUxUUXhJRGxWZXlRdFhrVVAzOWdOZHBFTnUzUUJwNDZFTkpuMUVLTWdv)). US lawmakers propose ban on Chinese military-linked employees ([VOA](https://news.google.)).
- **WuXi Lawsuit**: Chinese biotech firm sues US DoD over military-linked designation, challenging legal basis ([VOA](https://news.google.)).

**Signal**: These moves—military exercises, basing, sanctions, and legal disputes—suggest a deepening US-China confrontation that could escalate into a full-blown tech and military decoupling, with implications for global supply chains and regional stability.

海军与印太.zh:
印太海权博弈动态密集：美军航母在西太平洋活动频繁，中国辽宁舰编队仍在海上；土耳其成功试射AKYA重型鱼雷，希腊批准10亿欧元采购特种装备；法国启动新一代空射高超音速导弹研发。
- USNI报道：美海军“乔治·华盛顿”号航母在菲律宾海进行海上补给，中国辽宁舰编队亦在西太平洋活动。[西太平洋](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-june-12-2026)
- 土耳其海军在“Denizkurdu II”演习中从“MÜREN”综合作战系统成功发射AKYA重型鱼雷，完成实弹击沉测试。[土耳其鱼雷](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/sinkex-turkish-navy-achieves-first-akya-heavyweight-torpedo-firing-from-muren-cms/)
- 希腊议会批准超过10亿欧元采购10艘VICTA潜水员输送艇和10架V-BAT垂直起降无人机，强化特种作战能力。[希腊](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/greece-approves-acquisition-of-victa-diver-delivery-units-and-v-bat-drones/)
- 法国军备局（DGA）授予MBDA框架合同，开发第四代空对地核导弹ASN4G，预计搭载于未来战斗机。[法国](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/french-dga-commissions-mbda-to-develop-asn4g-hypersonic-missile/)
- 美国陆军在摩洛哥“非洲狮26”演习中，从登陆艇释放高空微型气球搭载无人机，测试远程通信与打击新概念。[气球](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-army-landing-craft-launches-drone-dropping-high-altitude-balloons/)

**判断**：印太与地中海两个“热区”同步升温，各国海军正加速采购新锐装备（鱼雷、无人机、载具）提升水下与近岸战力，高超音速武器竞赛亦在悄然推进。
海军与印太.en:
Naval and Indo-Pacific developments highlight both operational deployments and modernization programs. The US Navy is adjusting crew duties on USS Harry S. Truman (CVN-75) during its refueling and complex overhaul by contracting out supplementary work to free up sailors for core tasks ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/navy-wants-sailors-to-do-less-supplemental-work-on-uss-harry-s-truman-overhaul)). In the Western Pacific, USS George Washington (CVN-73) and the PLA Navy's Liaoning CSG are both operating in the Philippine Sea, a rare dual-carrier presence that underscores competition ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-june-12-2026)). France has commissioned MBDA to develop the ASN4G hypersonic nuclear missile, marking a leap in European strategic strike capability ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/french-dga-commissions-mbda-to-develop-asn4g-hypersonic-missile/)). The Turkish Navy successfully fired the AKYA heavyweight torpedo during a SINKEX exercise ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/sinkex-turkish-navy-achieves-first-akya-heavyweight-torpedo-firing-from-muren-cms/)). The US Army tested drone-dropping high-altitude balloons from a landing craft during African Lion 26, a novel launch effect for long-range communications and strikes ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-army-landing-craft-launches-drone-dropping-high-altitude-balloons/)). The Coast Guard and Eastern Shipbuilding terminated their Offshore Patrol Cutter contract after 10 years, raising questions about future acquisition ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/coast-guard-eastern-shipbuilding-terminate-offshore-patrol-cutter-contract-rick-scott-ends-promotion-holds)). Greece approved over €1 billion for VICTA diver delivery units and V-BAT drones ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/greece-approves-acquisition-of-victa-diver-delivery-units-and-v-bat-drones)). Indonesia selected French shipbuilder PIRIOU to build two research vessels ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/indonesia-chooses-piriou-to-build-two-research-vessels)).

- **Carrier Operations**: USS George Washington and Liaoning CSG in Philippine Sea, rare dual presence ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/usni-news-western-pacific-pulse-june-12-2026)).
- **French Hypersonic Missile**: DGA commissions MBDA to develop ASN4G nuclear air-to-ground missile ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/french-dga-commissions-mbda-to-develop-asn4g-hypersonic-missile/)).
- **Turkish Navy SINKEX**: First AKYA heavyweight torpedo firing from MÜREN CMS during Denizkurdu II exercise ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/sinkex-turkish-navy-achieves-first-akya-heavyweight-torpedo-firing-from-muren-cms/)).
- **US Army Balloon Test**: Drone-dropping high-altitude balloons from landing craft, new launched effect ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-army-landing-craft-launches-drone-dropping-high-altitude-balloons/)).
- **Coast Guard Program Termination**: 10-year OPC contract with Eastern Shipbuilding ended; future acquisition uncertain ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/12/coast-guard-eastern-shipbuilding-terminate-offshore-patrol-cutter-contract-rick-scott-ends-promotion-holds)).

**Watch next**: The dual carrier operations in the Philippine Sea could lead to close encounters or incidents if both navies operate in overlapping areas. French hypersonic development will likely prompt Russian and Chinese countermeasures. The OPC contract termination may delay US Coast Guard capabilities needed for Arctic and homeland security missions.

AI.zh: AI子专栏今日最大事件是**Anthropic被美国政府强制下线全新模型**，多信源交叉印证：Ars Technica报道商务部担心Fable 5被“越狱”构成国家安全威胁，Wired确认公司已按指令下线。Anthropic在博客中反驳称“有限越狱不应成为召回商用模型的原因”。与此同时，[乌克兰使用全自主无人机完成首次实战击杀](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/ukraines-one-time-test-used-fully-autonomous-drones-to-kill-russian-soldiers/)，标志AI武器伦理再临临界点。[中国一边限制西方模型一边允许美国公司使用DeepSeek](https://www.techradar.com/pro/the-great-ai-irony-china-cracks-down-on-western-models-while-us-companies-flock-to-deepseek)形成政策双标。社区方面，[开源AI必赢声明](https://opensourceaimustwin.com/)获559票，[Bloomberg评论](https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2026-06-12/ai-threatens-worker-motivation-unless-leaders-step-up)指出AI会“偷走员工的动力”。**收束判断**：政府直接行政干预AI模型部署且未设置期限，可能诱发更多国家效仿，加速开源/闭源路线分裂。
AI.en:
The AI desk is dominated by the U.S. government's forceful shutdown of Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models over a 'jailbreak' national security concern, a move that has triggered intense debate about AI governance and the balance of power between private companies and the state. Separately, Ukraine's first documented use of fully autonomous drones to engage human targets signals a stark military inflection point. The IPO pipeline is heating up with 'MANGOS'—Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceX among them—and the open-source community is mobilizing in response to regulatory overreach.

- **Anthropic forced to take Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline** after Commerce Department directive citing a serious jailbreak risk; Anthropic publicly disagrees, calling the recall unwarranted ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/anthropic-shuts-down-fable-mythos-models-following-trump-admin-directive/), [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/anthropic-says-us-government-ordered-it-to-shut-down-mythos-models/)).
- **Ukraine used fully autonomous drones** with AI decision-making to kill Russian soldiers in a one-time test, escalating the role of lethal autonomous weapons ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/ukraines-one-time-test-used-fully-autonomous-drones-to-kill-russian-soldiers/)).
- **IPO summer for AI and space**: SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI are part of the 'MANGOS' acronym heading to public markets, with SpaceX already delivering a 19% debut pop ([TechCrunch video](https://techcrunch.com/video/spacex-anthropic-and-openais-hot-ipo-summer/)).
- **Open source AI must win** campaign surges on Hacker News (559 points, 180 comments), arguing for decentralized development in response to government model bans ([OpenSourceAIMustWin](https://opensourceaimustwin.com/?share=v2)).
- **China cracks down on Western AI models** while U.S. companies flock to DeepSeek, highlighting a growing irony in cross-border AI flows ([TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/pro/the-great-ai-irony-china-cracks-down-on-western-models-while-us-companies-flock-to-deepseek)).

**Signal:** The Anthropic shutdown could set a precedent for government intervention in frontier AI, but the open-source response suggests the community will resist centralized control.

科技产品.zh: **SpaceX IPO**主导科技产品子专栏——首日涨19%推马斯克成万亿富翁，但Robinhood遭遇[“破纪录”流量中断](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/robinhood-sees-record-breaking-traffic-after-spacex-stock-debuts/)。争议同步爆发：The Verge[直接称](https://www.theverge.com/tech/949259/the-worlds-first-trillionaire-is-a-killer)“万亿富翁是杀人犯”。其他重要动态：[Mistral传闻融资30亿欧元估值200亿欧](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/mistral-is-rumored-to-be-raising-e3b-at-e20-valuation/)，逼近OpenAI估值水平；[Oracle PeopleSoft 0日漏洞](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/06/peoplesoft-0-day-affecting-hundreds-of-organizations-steals-gigabytes-of-data/)正窃取数百家企业数据；[Valve进口13吨VR头显](https://www.theverge.com/news/949517/valve-vr-headset-import-records-steam-frame-steam-machine-game-console)，或为新产品Steam Frame铺路；Nothing CEO[警告手机涨价](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/949403/nothing-carl-pei-ram-phone-prices)因内存短缺。**收束判断**：消费电子成本上行与安全漏洞频发形成双重压力，而SpaceX IPO引发的财富集中与道德质疑或影响后续监管议程。
科技产品.en:
The consumer tech world is electrified by SpaceX's IPO, which minted the world's first trillionaire and caused trading platform disruptions. Beyond the financial spectacle, major product news includes Valve's apparent mass shipment of its Steam Frame VR headset (13 tons imported in one day), a critical PeopleSoft vulnerability, and DJI vs. Insta360 patent battle. Mistral is reportedly raising €3B at a €20B valuation, signaling continued AI investment.

- **SpaceX IPO delivers world's first trillionaire** – Elon Musk's net worth crosses $1T after shares opened at $150 and closed up 19%; Robinhood experiences record-breaking traffic and intermittent outages ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-closes-up-19-and-delivers-the-worlds-first-trillionaire/), [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/elon-musk-is-the-worlds-first-trillionaire-wow/)).
- **Valve imports 13 tons of VR headsets** – likely the first mass production shipments of the Steam Frame, a new gaming headset, according to import records ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/news/949517/valve-vr-headset-import-records-steam-frame-steam-machine-game-console)).
- **PeopleSoft 0-day under active exploitation** – the Oracle-owned enterprise software vulnerability is stealing gigabytes of data from hundreds of organizations; rated extremely critical ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/06/peoplesoft-0-day-affecting-hundreds-of-organizations-steals-gigabytes-of-data/)).
- **DJI and Insta360 sue each other** over vlogging camera patents, escalating a legal battle in the fast-growing content creator hardware market ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2193431/dji-and-insta360-are-in-a-patent-battle-over-vlogging-cameras/)).
- **Mistral rumored to raise €3B at €20B valuation**, nearly doubling its Series C, as European AI champions gain momentum ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/mistral-is-rumored-to-be-raising-e3b-at-e20-valuation/)).

**Signal:** The SpaceX IPO's success may trigger a wave of high-profile tech listings, but the PeopleSoft zero-day and congressional lapse of a spying law remind us that cybersecurity and privacy are under strain.

汽车.zh: **小米家用机器人充电臂**刷屏——[Electrek报道](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/xiaomi-robotic-arm-ev-charger-tesla-snake-charger/)该装置仅152mm宽，可自动插拔，实现特斯拉2014年概念。**BYD野心凸显**：连续超越福特后[公开挑战丰田](https://news.google.)，目标五年内全球第一。**[BMW iX3实测续航500英里](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/bmw-new-ix3-drove-500-miles/)**，在海拔爬升和恶劣天气下达成。丰田[开启Hilux BEV电动皮卡订单](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/toyota-opens-orders-first-body-on-frame-ev-under-60000/)，起价低于6万美元。Wired曝光[中国司机用塑料头骗过特斯拉Autopilot](https://www.wired.com/story/chinese-drivers-are-using-tiny-plastic-heads-to-fool-teslas-autopilot-safeguards/)。**收束判断**：电动化从续航竞赛转向充电基础设施和规模争夺，中国厂商在自动化充电和价格战上领先，传统巨头加速反击。
汽车.en:
The automotive desk is all about electrification and range breakthroughs. BYD is making aggressive moves to become the world's largest automaker, touting a 1,000-km luxury sedan and having already outsold Ford. Xiaomi delivers on Tesla's abandoned robot charger concept, while BMW's new iX3 manages 500 miles on a single charge. Toyota enters the EV pickup fray with the Hilux BEV, and Chinese drivers are using plastic heads to trick Tesla's Autopilot safeguards.

- **BYD's 'Great Han' luxury EV** promises over 1,000 km (621 miles) of range; company aims to be world's largest automaker in five years ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/byd-launch-luxury-ev-sedan-with-1000-km-range/), [Electric Cars Report](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPbnVWRmhCOGFqSDhvZjU0cUlUdHd0MjRLM2luRG0zY0xxN2t3LW9uM1NxNHNNRW40V0JpQnAxX0hObmp2OUZnb21hcjJJZUFnR19kMlZmRllmbmp6VnpsUEpoTmhfZzFRYmFMWVBvNTJCSVF6aWR4QmZVVU56MEZJSVQxTDdXQ05kYWhvRzdCdXo5dTAzdXFwaW9jaEh4Y2sxaC1qQnViejY)).
- **Xiaomi launches home robotic arm EV charger** – a 152 mm-wide device that autonomously plugs and unplugs, fulfilling Tesla's 2014 'snake charger' vision ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/xiaomi-robotic-arm-ev-charger-tesla-snake-charger/)).
- **Toyota opens orders for Hilux BEV**, its first body-on-frame electric pickup, starting under $60,000 ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/toyota-opens-orders-first-body-on-frame-ev-under-60000/)).
- **BMW iX3 prototype drives 500 miles** on a single charge through rain and snow, demonstrating impressive real-world efficiency ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/12/bmw-new-ix3-drove-500-miles/)).
- **Chinese drivers use plastic heads to fool Tesla Autopilot** – a cottage industry of celebrity figurines and blinking screens to bypass distracted-driving controls ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/chinese-drivers-are-using-tiny-plastic-heads-to-fool-teslas-autopilot-safeguards/)).

**Signal:** BYD's aggressive range claims and global ambitions, combined with Xiaomi's practical innovation, suggest the EV market is heading toward a hyper-competitive era where range and convenience are key battlegrounds.

HackNews社区动态.zh: 社区今日热点集中在**安全与开源路线**。[FFmpeg被曝21个零日漏洞](https://depthfirst.com/research/21-zero-days-in-ffmpeg)（160票）成为最受关注技术帖，基础库安全风险引发广泛讨论；[Palantir在瑞士败诉](https://www.ft.com/content/7ffcace7-9dc0-4e7e-9912-895ac073f979)（253票），调查杂志获胜，监管隐私战再下一城；[Renault无稀土电机技术](https://www.renaultgroup.com/en/magazine/energy-and-powertrains/all-about-electric-motors-with-no-rare-earths/)获331票社区追捧，呼应供应链自主需求。此外，Apple工程师[用Swift重写TrueType解释器](https://www.swift.org/blog/migrating-truetype-hinting-to-swift/)（178票）展示迁移经验；[开源AI必赢声明](https://opensourceaimustwin.com/)（559票）结合今日Anthropic被关停背景，引发强烈共鸣。**收束判断**：社区在安全漏洞和监管干预双重刺激下，对“去中心化”与“开源”的认同显著上升，短期可能推动更多开发者转向非受控模型。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community is buzzing with technical deep dives and security revelations. A researcher reported 21 zero-day vulnerabilities in FFmpeg, while Palantir lost a legal challenge against a Swiss investigative magazine. Renault's exploration of rare-earth-free electric motors gained 331 points, and a daily mini golf game 'Putt.day' became a surprise hit. The community also engaged heavily with the Anthropic model shutdown, with a popular response post calling out the irony.

- **21 zero-days found in FFmpeg** – a comprehensive security audit reveals critical flaws in the widely used multimedia library; users urged to patch immediately ([Depth First](https://depthfirst.com/research/21-zero-days-in-ffmpeg)).
- **Palantir loses legal challenge** against Swiss investigative magazine; the court ruling has broad implications for corporate litigation against press freedom ([FT](https://www.ft.com/content/7ffcace7-9dc0-4e7e-9912-895ac073f979)).
- **Renault shares details on rare-earth-free electric motors** – a technical overview of alternative motor designs that avoid supply chain dependency, with strong community interest (331 points) ([Renault Group](https://www.renaultgroup.com/en/magazine/energy-and-powertrains/all-about-electric-motors-with-no-rare-earths/)).
- **'Putt.day' – a daily mini golf game** – Show HN project gains 120 points and 64 comments, demonstrating the enduring appeal of simple, fun web games ([Putt.day](https://putt.day/)).
- **Community response to US ban on Fable 5/Mythos 5** – a blog post criticizing the government's move receives 41 points, reflecting the Hacker News audience's tension with regulatory overreach ([Isaacus](https://isaacus.com/blog/our-response-to-the-us-ban-on-fable-5-and-mythos-5)).

**Signal:** The FFmpeg zero-days pose a widespread security risk, while the community's engagement with AI governance and sustainable engineering signals a shift toward more critical and resilient tech development.

足球.zh:
**足球小专栏**：世界杯揭幕战东道主美国队4-1大胜巴拉圭，巴洛贡的双响炮和45分钟统治级表现让质疑者闭嘴。不过VAR再次抢戏，出现“认错人”的黄牌闹剧，引发球迷热议。英格兰队在抵达堪萨斯城前遭遇训练器材失窃，虽未影响比赛行程但为备战增添变数。

- [USA start World Cup in style - but will they finally join the elite?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c621z2k51rdo) — BBC分析美国队能否借主场之利跻身世界强队之列。
- [Balogun stars in impressive USA win over Paraguay](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/videos/cwydp9463wko) — 巴洛贡两球，美国4-1轻取巴拉圭。
- [VAR makes 'mistaken identity' history as strange booking confuses fans](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c5yze890365o) — VAR错认球员，黄牌判罚引发混乱。
- [England have training equipment stolen](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cwyldy8w0jpo) — 英格兰训练装备失窃，索斯盖特面临临场调整。

开局势头良好，但东道主能否将状态延续到淘汰赛仍是悬念；英格兰的小插曲或许只是前奏，真正的挑战在场上。
足球.en:
The football desk is dominated by the USA's stunning World Cup opener, with Folarin Balogun scoring twice in a 4-1 win over Paraguay. A bizarre VAR 'mistaken identity' booking has sparked debate, while England suffered a training equipment theft ahead of their match. A split among pundits over a potential red card in Bosnia-Canada adds to the officiating discussion. Several non-football items (cricket, tennis, F1, golf, rugby) were also filed under this desk but are excluded from this brief.

- **[USA start World Cup in style - but will they finally join the elite?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c621z2k51rdo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The 45-minute blitz that dispelled host-nation pressure; Balogun's performance suggests the US can compete with top teams.
- **[VAR makes 'mistaken identity' history as strange booking confuses fans](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c5yze890365o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The incident left everyone 'scratching their heads' and could fuel VAR reform calls.
- **[England have training equipment stolen](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cwyldy8w0jpo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — A logistical blow ahead of Kansas City arrival; security concerns for traveling teams are now highlighted.
- **['Clear red' for Bosnia or 'wins the ball'? BBC pundits disagree](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c2lyd45wl7no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)** — The draw between Bosnia and Canada was marred by a controversial refereeing decision that splits expert opinion.

This desk signals that the World Cup is already producing talking points beyond the scoreline; officiating and off-field incidents are as impactful as the results.

篮球.zh:
**篮球小专栏**：国内篮球圈聚焦iQOO×NBA高校篮球赛总决赛，朱芳雨、郭艾伦、特奎维恩等名将齐聚北大，还有一位“神秘大咖”号称国内唯一NBA+CBA双冠王，吊足胃口。同时，CBA外援贾卡尔·桑普森被巴林男篮归化，本赛季他在广厦场均11+7，成为亚洲篮坛又一归化案例。

- [来，陪你玩到底！CBA“三分雨”朱芳雨空降北大！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8wVkZ1emNvSUF4RVFRUnl6cU9nd1dLckxFUUZhaURpU2JaYmRtMnpBOHBsd0l5dWxVblhNOC1oSU8tTHV3amx3V2M5ZU5qTTc5cjdzaFhWVGZjMllQOVlwUW9OMA) — 朱芳雨6月14日北大助阵高校篮球赛总决赛。
- [郭艾伦、朱芳雨、特奎维恩已就位，还有一位神秘大咖是谁呢？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1PMUpLNWp0a1RZMjl6THRVTjJmODFQUmRLQVU0V3FWWWFVN1Z5LVZWdjFVUU51UjRaZVdJN0NOMGZiVFZjbFZDcklYTnZMTG0yclpmN2lxTFZyMms5TXVGRWo3bw) — 神秘双冠王引猜测，赛事话题热度飙升。
- [本赛季在CBA场均11+7！巴林男篮归化广厦外援贾卡尔·桑普森！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQQmZtcGVRUTh1dG5aY1hWUzVLRjBETERmei1wN09EeFp5MG5HQkFvdFpMMmR6RE9rMmdMeU9Za3hjNmVXeXZHb3hFZXVRTE5jOWFjbXU3TTJGSVZ1X0JNbHFJWFBnNjVnUmFyeDFJZERVNzJuUnkzR3pqZUw5SVlzdE9LeVU) — 桑普森加入巴林国家队，亚洲篮球版图再添变数。

高校篮球赛星光熠熠，但比赛本身才是核心；归化桑普森能否帮助巴林男篮提升竞争力，值得后续关注。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball is abuzz with the upcoming iQOO x NBA高校篮球赛 final at Peking University on June 14. Former CBA star Zhu Fangyu, alongside Guo Ailun and a mystery NBA/CBA dual champion, will attend, emphasizing the growing partnership between tech brands and university sports. Additionally, Bahrain national team has naturalized CBA import Jakaar Sampson, a move that could impact Asian basketball dynamics.

- **[来，陪你玩到底！CBA“三分雨”朱芳雨空降北大！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8wVkZ1emNvSUF4RVFRUnl6cU9nd1dLckxFUUZhaURpU2JaYmRtMnpBOHBsd0l5dWxVblhNOC1oSU8tTHV3amx3V2M5ZU5qTTc5cjdzaFhWVGZjMllQOVlwUW9OMA)** — Zhu Fangyu, a legendary CBA shooter, will attend the iQOO × NBA高校篮球赛 final, bridging pro basketball and campus culture.
- **[郭艾伦、朱芳雨、特奎维恩已就位，还有一位神秘大咖...](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1PMUpLNWp0a1RZMjl6THRVTjJmODFQUmRLQVU0V3FWWWFVN1Z5LVZWdjFVUU51UjRaZVdJN0NOMGZiVFZjbFZDcklYTnZMTG0yclpmN2lxTFZyMms5TXVGRWo3bw)** — The mystery guest, hinted as the only player with both NBA and CBA championships, adds star power and speculation.
- **[本赛季在CBA场均11+7！巴林男篮归化广厦外援贾卡尔·桑普森！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQQmZtcGVRUTh1dG5aY1hWUzVLRjBETERmei1wN09EeFp5MG5HQkFvdFpMMmR6RE9rMmdMeU9Za3hjNmVXeXZHb3hFZXVRTE5jOWFjbXU3TTJGSVZ1X0JNbHFJWFBnNjVnUmFyeDFJZERVNzJuUnkzR3pqZUw5SVlzdE9LeVU)** — Jakaar Sampson, averaging 11+7 in CBA for Guangsha, becomes naturalized for Bahrain, potentially strengthening their national team for future competitions.

The iQOO event underscores the commercialization of Chinese college basketball, while Sampson's naturalization reflects the growing trend of Asian countries tapping CBA talent.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
**虎扑社区小专栏**：虎扑社区今日热度集中在电竞赛事——LCK联赛中HLE击败T1，Gumayusi虽败犹荣，成为历史上首位连续五年晋级MSI的选手。T1粉丝和黑粉在虎扑JRs之声中激烈交锋，讨论战术与选手表现。此外，社区内还有关于张杰、谢娜的娱乐八卦以及虎扑自身流量被小红书“看不上”的自嘲话题。

- [[情报站]Gumayusi成为历史首位连续五年晋级MSI的选手](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBGSU5xaHpoNHpLbWMyc3k0ODBzTUxsY2R6ZFZaUlF4OVJVZmVKaDJ2eVdXYklvUmdQWDM3ZHlUNFZxSVY0YnI4OGZNVTFTRTZJSTRTY05nVl9qM2RXclRmek9sMA) — Gumayusi连续五年MSI，前四次成绩为亚军+两次季军+亚军。
- [【虎扑JRs之声】热议#T1对战HLE#](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9adHpfZmtSWm4tMk1IM3JCZjJUdFFVSG5sYXVrR0VROW53V2tPZkNlSXhURmpBZUR5QUE0Zld1S2xMbXU2ZGRZeXVBaUNUNGExNExERkhEUGI1Y25BakZtdUUyRQ) — 社区玩家点评：操作型上单、爱玩野核的打野、对线好的中单、抗压下路、后期浪被翻盘，这队像谁？
- [虎扑的三瓜俩枣，小红书怕是看不上](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTFBJSzFFX2ZCX2FFV3AwdWRPNnZVb1hkOVA5LTdqMzlWYWpnMmJnZ0dyZmFaUjNZbm1qcXhfdTRmQTROUEhLb0wxU0cyZVg3V0pwS0NTYWY2aUZ3ck5wZnlMeFY2X2xKWUl6NFdFVmVISk5fZWdpUUww) — 虎扑用户自嘲平台流量被小红书轻视。

虎扑社区动态.en:

Gumayusi's achievement of five consecutive MSI appearances is celebrated, but fans dissect T1's weaknesses. Meanwhile, a humorous World Cup simulation post and a gossip thread about Zhang Jie and Xie Na show the diverse range of community discussions.

- [2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛1/4决赛综述：中国队锁定男双决赛席位，董天尧延续惊喜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPcnFrZ3YxWTNKU2t6YkZsU2pDWldKeUlfUl9qbnZHY1RLLWhlWHEzbkVPMUtSdWlfWk9RbmRGanQxQzk1czE4YmpfNk5nQzdXc0NCTjRwZlkxR0dnNEgwY292OGtvMWJTMWtCblZWZEdTOVJnem5abDBEVGkzUGFuX2NhWW9qXzFjUDlwa3RucmZOV041Z05EOFV0ZlhDM184SjhhWURPUQ) — 董天尧再创惊喜，国羽男双锁定一席决赛权。

董天尧的崛起为年轻选手树立榜样，决赛日国羽有望带回更多冠军。
羽毛球.en:
At the 2026 Australian Open badminton quarterfinals, China has secured a men's doubles final berth, while young player Dong Tianyao continues to surprise. The tournament is a key stop on the BWF World Tour, with implications for Olympic qualifying.

- **[2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛1/4决赛综述：中国队锁定男双决赛席位，董天尧延续惊喜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPcnFrZ3YxWTNKU2t6YkZsU2pDWldKeUlfUl9qbnZHY1RLLWhlWHEzbkVPMUtSdWlfWk9RbmRGanQxQzk1czE4YmpfNk5nQzdXc0NCTjRwZlkxR0dnNEgwY292OGtvMWJTMWtCblZWZEdTOVJnem5abDBEVGkzUGFuX2NhWW9qXzFjUDlwa3RucmZOV041Z05EOFV0ZlhDM184SjhhWURPUQ)** — China's doubles pair reached the final; Dong Tianyao's run adds depth to China's singles prospects ahead of the World Championships.
- The tournament continues to serve as a benchmark for form among top shuttlers, with only one Chinese men's doubles pair left, but a chance to reclaim title.

This desk indicates steady progress for Chinese badminton, though the lack of singles dominance remains a concern. Keep an eye on the finals for potential rankings shifts.

欧美.zh:
好莱坞并购大戏与艾美奖投票同步升温，产业整合与人文关怀并存。

- [华纳兄弟1110亿美元出售给派拉蒙获司法部批准](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjwgled9jxwo)，交易覆盖CNN、HBO，预计将催生新内容巨头。
- [艾美奖提名投票进入最后冲刺](https://deadline.com/2026/06/emmy-nomination-voting-hits-fever-pitch-notes-on-the-season-1236955423/)，555个节目竞争席位，下周揭晓入围名单。
- [Ariana Grande成立“Brighter Days Ahead”基金会](https://deadline.com/2026/06/ariana-grande-brighter-days-ahead-foundation-1236955560/)，专注青年心理健康与艺术教育，首批合作伙伴已确认。
- [ABC7老牌主播Bill Ritter因阿尔茨海默症辞别荧幕](https://deadline.com/2026/06/bill-ritter-alzheimers-new-york-news-anchor-1236955433/)，27年新闻生涯在哽咽中落幕。

欧美产业在资本整合与个体告别的双重叙事中前行，艾美奖提名将验证“内容为王”是否依然成立。
欧美.en:
The US and European entertainment industry is absorbed by a historic merger approval and a wave of PR launches, awards season maneuvering, and celebrity philanthropy. The Warner Bros-Paramount $111bn deal approval by the DOJ reshapes the studio landscape, while Roku's sale talks add to the M&A narrative. Meanwhile, the Emmy race enters a critical voting weekend with 555 programs competing.

- **Warner Bros-Paramount merger approved** – The US Justice Department greenlit the $111 billion acquisition, paving the way for a combined entity owning CNN, HBO, Paramount, and Warner Bros. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjwgled9jxwo)). This will likely trigger antitrust scrutiny in other markets and alter streaming strategies.
- **Roku stock jumps on sale talks** – Shares rose 20% after Bloomberg reported that the streaming platform is exploring a sale ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/roku-for-sale-stock-jumps-20-percent-on-report-1236620804/)). Potential buyers include tech and media conglomerates, which could consolidate the ad-supported streaming sector.
- **Emmy nomination voting heats up** – With ballots due this weekend, Deadline notes that the sheer volume of entries (555 programs) makes this one of the most competitive years. The DGA's new contract includes AI training and health plan improvements, setting a precedent for other guilds ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/emmy-nomination-voting-hits-fever-pitch-notes-on-the-season-1236955423/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/directors-guilds-four-year-deal-plan-1236620542/)).
- **Ariana Grande launches Brighter Days Ahead Foundation** – The foundation will fund youth mental health and arts education, with initial grants to small nonprofits ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/ariana-grande-brighter-days-ahead-foundation-1236955560/)). This could inspire other artists to create similar philanthropic vehicles.
- **Veteran PR exec Adam Keen launches Agenda Collective** – The new firm will handle film, TV, and awards campaigns for clients including A24 and Amazon MGM Studios ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/adam-keen-agenda-collective-pr-firm-1236780200/)), signaling continued demand for specialized entertainment PR.

**Signal:** The convergence of M&A, labor deals, and awards activity suggests 2026 will be a year of structural realignment in Hollywood; watch for further consolidation among agencies and streaming platforms.

日韩.zh:
K-pop双雄接连刷新纪录，韩剧收视与情怀并行。

- [BOYNEXTDOOR正规一辑《HOME》5天突破百万销量](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847429wpp/boynextdoors-home-becomes-their-4th-million-seller-album)，成为组合第四张百万专辑，巩固新生代领头羊地位。
- [BTS数字单曲《Come Over》登顶全球iTunes](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847422wpp/bts-dominates-itunes-charts-all-over-the-world-with-come-over)，延续《ARIRANG》专辑长尾效应。
- [《我的皇家宿敌》获本周收视最高迷你剧](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847419wpp/my-royal-nemesis-is-most-watched-miniseries-of-the-week)，林智妍与许南俊的对手戏持续吸睛。
- [《鬼怪》10周年重聚特别节目曝光预告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847391wpp/watch-goblin-cast-reunites-with-the-same-chaotic-yet-heartfelt-chemistry-in-10th-anniversary-trip-teaser)，孔刘金高银等原班人马回归，情怀牌蓄势待发。

日韩市场以新老组合同时爆发，证明K-content的多元吸引力。
日韩.en:
K-pop and Korean drama continue their global momentum with BOYNEXTDOOR achieving a fourth million-seller album, BTS dominating iTunes charts, and the drama 'My Royal Nemesis' leading weekly ratings. A nostalgic 'Goblin' reunion special is also generating buzz as the classic drama celebrates its 10th anniversary.

- **BOYNEXTDOOR's 'HOME' becomes 4th million-seller** – The album sold over 1 million copies in less than five days, marking a new milestone for the group ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847429wpp/boynextdoors-home-becomes-their-4th-million-seller-album)). This solidifies their position as a leading boy group alongside BTS.
- **BTS's 'Come Over' sweeps iTunes charts globally** – Released as a digital single, the track has topped charts in dozens of countries ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847422wpp/bts-dominates-itunes-charts-all-over-the-world-with-come-over)). The song's inclusion on the deluxe vinyl edition of 'ARIRANG' shows strategic release planning.
- **'My Royal Nemesis' remains most-watched miniseries** – The SBS romantic comedy maintained its Friday primetime lead and was the most-watched miniseries of the week ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847419wpp/my-royal-nemesis-is-most-watched-miniseries-of-the-week)). The show's blend of historical possession and modern romance continues to resonate.
- **'Goblin' cast reunion special teased** – A 10th anniversary trip program featuring the original cast of 'Guardian: The Lonely and Great God' has released a teaser, promising nostalgic chemistry ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847391wpp/watch-goblin-cast-reunites-with-the-same-chaotic-yet-heartfelt-chemistry-in-10th-anniversary-trip-teaser)). This taps into the enduring popularity of the 2016 drama.
- **June boy group brand reputation rankings: BTS still #1** – The Korean Business Research Institute's monthly index shows BTS leading, with other groups like SEVENTEEN and NCT following ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1847415wpp/june-boy-group-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-9)). Brand reputation directly impacts endorsement deals and CF opportunities.

**Signal:** K-pop's sales and chart dominance remain robust, but the industry is increasingly relying on nostalgia and reunion content; expect more anniversary specials as the second-generation K-pop stars age.

- [胖东来创始人于东来“员工不值这么多钱”言论引热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE9paDdXUFpVSGM1eTR0TnptZVlhc0E3OG54YkdoeGNHUDltX1NJdGZtaUw0Ui1CeTV5ZVdzRkRHMzFqMm9aVmlFV3RTSkxkM0hoUVotQ3BKNGt6TnBmMlM2SNIBZkFVX3lxTE1YbTB4dHg1cEdSWnhlNlpwZC03Nk9XclBadGNZNTBQeDVUdV94QmhzNjlRdFBmVTBzZDJEOWpGZjVHMFJRUmJ2dWZaQ0hkNklyQmFOVnM1VFM0RzhueFpRQ01fc1luQQ)，网友两极评价，打工情绪借娱乐话题爆发。

微博生态仍以八卦为流量引擎，但社会情绪通过明星言论找到出口。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media was ablaze with celebrity drama, from Dilraba Dilmurat and Chen Feiyu's rumored romance to He Jiong's on-stage rescue of a tearful Na Ying. These stories drove massive traffic and highlight the power of fandom culture and live TV incidents in China's entertainment ecosystem.

- **Dilraba and Chen Feiyu rumored romance tops trending list** – The alleged secret relationship between Dilraba Dilmurat and Chen Feiyu became the No.1 trending topic on Weibo ([新浪网](https://news.google.)). Both parties denied the rumors, but the event still generated millions of engagements.
- **He Jiong saves Na Ying during emotional breakdown** – During a live taping, Na Ying became uncontrollably emotional and He Jiong stepped in to calm her and redirect the show ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxPTU9ORTBwVmZxT2YwUzY1NkhYbVRya3Atd0dVZ0NZaEFJelNBeUJ6dnNqV1NDMW0ybGk1MTFQSkgxUHdfLXRocXZoUW13TmRIZDU4Q1NZcHZYN3NPdHNrekhteUxrLWMxem16aFNNd0VHWHJBdUNubkJJd3FjTTN3Uw)). The incident sparked discussion about mental health and professionalism in Chinese entertainment.
- **'Singer 2026' audience sighting of Feng Jianyu** – Feng Jianyu was spotted in the audience of the popular music show, wearing a leopard-print coat that trended online; he delayed his own livestream to watch the performance ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNS2pLMkdDNnhaQi00WDd0Y3JRaV9kMUFkQXh0cHI4amlENTFtYjV2M3AzX3JJSDFXS0paYmlpenUxcGlCTy1BR3NKMVY4QVdGUExHZEo3TTNVNzI1dlVfLWRYY2tfV1g3ZlFhUS15MEZTcUNVc0xZaHRvT3NycDVwTU9EWlJGLURIbTVJWDNraV8wQzVFUDJtcHU4eUg4cHppTEV2Tmlvb0Y)). This cross-promotion between idol activities and music competition shows is a growing trend.
- **Dilraba's follower count spikes** – The actress gained a significant number of new followers amid the romance rumors ([手机新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBYQ20xOXRzSEc2N0xXT0xVdFhJUlZEZndqVUkxNHM1WEtmX21MYVFHRDBscWhpM2k4R3J3LXBnN1o4eThEN1lhY0x2aS1oQ2s4VFFvVjNmcmY4bEVWT3VhenNaRQ)), demonstrating the direct correlation between scandal and fan engagement metrics.

**Signal:** The Weibo ecosystem rewards unverified gossip and emotional live moments; brands and agencies must navigate these volatile attention cycles carefully to avoid reputational whiplash.

中国.zh:
行业规范与技术革新双管齐下，中国影视加速去流量化。

- [三协会联合出台演员署名新规，7月起按笔画排序](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOY2JVVDFna0Frd19fNnhoTUJOa3k1LXQ4WjYySHBCZW1JalhIeGdzc05CQV9TeWNpQ19nZTF2UHNqYTJnTVRmVFVNTndmZnMzdWNwME5qbkhwUUNlN0ZBMlprWVZtS2FrTGJUcnV4QjY4LURfUThaRFh4YVVyWTg4eThPTlp0NUk3anlmcXZzUDdjMi1TZ0F4Uw)，这是对长期“撕番”乱象的釜底抽薪。
- [上海国际电影节产业论坛聚焦IP长期主义](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE9BU1M0MXBtZDB1ZnluUjZvb0IzQjVOU05ybEFVM2RqSVMydVJySm15dS1WQVVhWTUyOFJkSGdvWHRvRjdJeUthMTRjVE1TYXhqSmcydkFNVElGSDlYbk9sb0I0SmxLZw)，认为票房波动是IP经济爆发的蓄势期，呼吁构建全域消费生态。
- [移动AI技术助力横店一键切换仙侠场景](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBBS2MzWXJyY0JlTHM4bjBSOFd2VTVNYnBRaFRtZnpQVk40alpXNzVlZmFaVUlnN1VNNHlFYm9VeEE5blZKSjB6aFItUGVxNGN2QlZYRE1qQQ)，AI赋能影视制作降本增效。
- [华策桐庐AIGC影视创制中心正式启用](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFB0VkFnNHVpNnpWblI1Q1E3cm9JNDNRZmxHbWN2X2I1ZEE5NGxWkhYRVVOSkNaUEdBbE1tR2piM3BIWEczQU9EdlpOZ21BMURNUXVUMkszOFdjVGR6dEE)，成为国内首个AI影视制作示范区，旨在打造“中国版好莱坞”。

中国影视正从资本泡沫转向制度规范与技术赋能的双轮驱动，但AI替代人工的隐忧也在行业讨论中浮现。
中国.en:
China's entertainment industry is undergoing intense regulatory and technological transformation. Three industry associations jointly issued new rules to end 'credit-stealing' in actor rankings, effective July, while the Shanghai International Film Festival opened with a focus on IP long-termism and AI-powered production. High-profile appearances by Zhang Ziyi and Donnie Yen at a state event also drew attention.

- **New credit-ranking rules to end 'credit wars'** – Starting July 1, all Chinese film/TV productions must list actors' names strictly by stroke count of surnames, enforced by three major associations ([orientaldaily.com.my](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5rM0cwMzgtVGVkNUZ2aEJiR1Z3NkViaWM0UExEN3B2UVZLdHpRVGFodmZ4cmdjdjhpNXctbEdhRjYzNkZ1dVowU0pkcnZPaVZqbVZSMDJTdkpEMmRkOVhDUGhTdTdHX0xzMVhqVWlfZkdiNGRHNHk4TA)). This will reshape how contracts and promotional materials are negotiated, and could reduce on-set conflicts.
- **Shanghai International Film Festival opens with industry forum** – Discussions centered on 'IP long-termism' and how to transform box office volatility into sustainable consumer ecosystems ([每日经济新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE9BU1M0MXBtZDB1ZnluUjZvb0IzQjVOU05ybEFVM2RqSVMydVJySm15dS1WQVVhWTUyOFJkSGdvWHRvRjdJeUthMTRjVE1TYXhqSmcydkFNVElGSDlYbk9sb0I0SmxLZw)). The forum signals that the industry is seeking stable revenue beyond theatrical windows.
